items.title: 台新證打國際盃 找這7家電子業開國際法人閉門會議
items.title_en: Taishin Securities Hosts International Cup, Invites 7 Electronics Companies to Closed-Door Corporate Meeting
paras: 為深化台灣資本市場與國際資金鏈結，台新證券攜手櫃買中心和7家國內優質上櫃企業，赴新加坡盛大舉辦「TPEx & Taishin Taiwan Corporate Day」，與新加坡主權基金、專業投資機構、大型資產管理公司及保險機構等近20家國際法人接觸交流。
本次獲邀赴星的7家績優上櫃企業，包括弘塑(3131-TW)、雙鴻(3324-TW)、臺慶科(3357-TW)、力旺(3529-TW)、家登(3680-TW)、信驊(5274-TW)和台半(5425-TW)，產業範疇橫跨先進封裝濕製程設備、散熱模組、電感元件、嵌入式非揮發性記憶體IP、半導體光罩載具、遠端伺服器管理晶片及功率半導體等關鍵領域。
台新證說明，此次共同參與國內上櫃業者均是全球供應鏈和台灣資本市場極具代表性的領頭羊，透過一對一閉門座談及小型團體會議，有助台灣資本市場國際能見度。
台新證券總經理陳立國認為，全球AI產業加速發展、科技供應鏈持續重組，台灣憑藉完整的半導體及ICT產業聚落，在全球科技供應鏈的戰略地位日益受到國際資本關注，而新加坡兼具東協門戶及國際金融中心優勢，匯聚主權基金、資產管理機構和國際投資資金。
台新證看準新加坡市場的資金動能，正積極推動海外法人交流，協助台灣優質企業與國際投資人建立更直接、深度的溝通管道。
陳立國進一步說明，此次赴星引資，也充分展現台新新光金控跨境、跨業整合綜效，透過台新銀行新加坡分行深耕東南亞市場的在地資源與法人客戶網絡，串聯起證券與銀行多元金融服務能量。
paras_en: To deepen the connection between Taiwan's capital market and international capital flows, Taishin Securities partnered with the OTC Exchange and seven high-quality domestic listed companies to hold a grand "TPEx & Taishin Taiwan Corporate Day" in Singapore, engaging with nearly 20 international institutions such as Singapore sovereign funds, professional investment firms, large asset managers, and insurance companies.

The seven invited high-performing listed companies are Hong Su (3131‑TW), Shuang Hong (3324‑TW), Taiqing Technology (3357‑TW), Li Wang (3529‑TW), Jia Deng (3680‑TW), Xin Hua (5274‑TW) and Taiwan Semiconductor (5425‑TW), covering key sectors including advanced packaging wet‑process equipment, heat‑dissipation modules, inductors, embedded non‑volatile memory IP, semiconductor photomask carriers, remote server management chips, and power semiconductors.

Taishin Securities explained that the participating domestic listed firms are leading representatives of the global supply chain and Taiwan's capital market, and that one‑on‑one closed‑door talks and small‑group meetings will help raise the international visibility of Taiwan's capital market.

Taishin Securities General Manager Chen Liguo said that as the global AI industry accelerates and the tech supply chain continues to restructure, Taiwan's comprehensive semiconductor and ICT ecosystem is gaining increasing strategic importance in the global tech supply chain, attracting international capital attention. Singapore, with its dual role as an ASEAN gateway and international financial hub, gathers sovereign funds, asset managers, and international investment capital.

Taishin Securities sees strong capital momentum in the Singapore market and is actively promoting overseas institutional exchanges to help high‑quality Taiwanese companies establish more direct and deeper communication channels with international investors.

Chen Liguo further noted that this investment‑attraction trip to Singapore also showcases the cross‑border and cross‑industry synergy of Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding, leveraging the local resources and corporate client network of Taishin Bank's Singapore branch in Southeast Asia to link the securities and banking divisions' diversified financial services.

items.title: Google搜尋業務失速後換亞馬遜零售業！科技巨頭搖錢樹接連踢鐵板 現金流惡化引發拋售潮
paras: 正當投資市場圍繞人工智慧(AI)打轉時，拼命砸錢擴張的科技巨頭卻接連在核心業務上踢到鐵板：亞馬遜(AMZN-US)賴以成名的零售業務表現不如預期，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)問題則是出在搜尋業務成長放緩，兩者股價都因此暴跌。

Alphabet搜尋和廣告業務疲弱、現金缺口擴大

Alphabet周四終場狂瀉12.3%至每股282.32美元，創下上市以來最慘財報後表現。該公司第3季自由現金流為負90.7億美元，顯示現金缺口在第2季首度出現之後進一步擴大，而且遠低於分析師預估的負27億美元。
Alphabet周三公布的財報顯示，攸關AI發展的Google Cloud表現亮眼，營收較去年同期倍增，遠優於市場預期，營業利益率達38%，比華爾街共識預估高出2.3個百分點。
但核心的Google搜尋與YouTube廣告業務卻表現疲弱，
而且自由現金流連兩季為負，缺口從第2季的59億美元擴大至91億美元，遠遜於分析師預估的27億美元。

亞馬遜零售與廣告業務遜色、現金流連三季為負

亞馬遜公布財報後，周四(29日)盤後一度下挫逾7%，在公布財報前，亞馬遜股價今年來累計上漲5.6%。
財報顯示，亞馬遜第3季每股獲利1.89美元，低於去年同期的1.95美元和分析師預估的1.97美元。淨銷售額年增12%至2,019億美元，略低於華爾街預估的2,022億美元。
主力的零售業務成長正在放緩：北美部門第3季銷售額年增6%至1,129億美元，低於市場所估的1,132億美元，國際部門銷售額年增5%至431億美元，也比市場預期少約5億美元。
在廣告業務方面，與Google類似，亞馬遜也顯露疲態，年增率從前一季的26%放緩至12%。
目前還無法期待亞馬遜的業績能立即回溫，因為該公司對第4季的財測同樣令人失望：亞馬遜預估本季營業利益中值為310億美元，遠低於分析師預期的332億美元。

AWS成長強勁 雲端業務仍是亮點

攸關AI隸屬的雲端業務仍是亮點，亞馬遜網路服務(AWS)第3季營收年增39%至460億美元，優於分析師預期。
但AWS也並非毫無問題。AI資料中心興建成本使亞馬遜連續三季的自由現金流為負。此外，亞馬遜維持2026年資本支出預估在2,200億美元不變，這是投資人現階段最關注的財務指標之一。
Direxion資本市場主管Jake Behan表示：「AWS成長加速，讓AI投資更容易獲得合理解釋，但不代表成本就此消失。資料中心建置仍使自由現金流承受重大壓力。」

Anthropic為AWS帶來風險

市場也正高度關注AWS因Anthropic面臨的風險。Anthropic本周一公布首次公開發行(IPO)公開說明書，提及亞馬遜及AWS共166次，而且Anthropic也是AWS近期業績表現的重要推動力，AWS成長率開始加速的時間點，恰好與Anthropic銷售額激增相吻合。
亞馬遜與Anthropic的關係相當複雜：亞馬遜既是競爭對手，也是經銷商、客戶及供應商。Anthropic上市後，亞馬遜還將成為持股逾5%的股東。
其中最大的風險，在於Anthropic與AWS簽訂的10年期、總額1,100億美元合約，然而這還只是Anthropic與多家雲端服務商簽訂的眾多合約之一。
當亞馬遜、Alphabet、微軟(MSFT-US)、SpaceX(SPCX-US)、超微(AMD-US)、博通(AVGO-US)、Nscale及Lambda都寄望Anthropic未來有能力支付龐大帳單，一旦Anthropic陷入困境，連鎖效應便可能接連發生。

items.title: 華航787新機躍2027年月曆主題 展現職人團隊服務
items.title_en: China Airlines' New 787 Aircraft Featured in 2027 Calendar Theme Showcasing Craftsmanship Team Service
paras: 華航(2610-TW)將迎接全新787客機，因此，2027年月曆以「飛閱787夢幻時刻」為主題，並聚焦團隊合作精神，串起華航的職人專業與服務，華航強調，從多元視角記錄各個部門為新機到來的準備與投入，傳遞全體團隊攜手迎接787的共同使命。
月曆自1月黎明機坪揭開序幕，機師、空服、地勤及修護人員同框，展現喜迎新機的全新氣象；2月聚焦發動機及修護細節，傳遞三萬英呎的從容，源自毫米堅持；3、4月前往地勤與貨運作業現場，呈現對旅客行李到珍貴貨物的細心守護；5月登機走入客艙篇章，暖心迎賓的細緻服務，逐月揭開787不同的客艙空間及體驗。
6月及7月將玉山晨曦、合歡山雲霧融入787客艙迎賓飾板設計，營造東方美學氛圍與尊榮質感；8月、9月及10月分別走進豪華經濟艙、經濟艙及豪華商務艙三艙等；11月深入駕駛艙，呈現機師專注飛行的身影，守護每趟飛行；12月則由天色漸亮中的787啟程，象徵邁向嶄新旅程的全新篇章。
2027年華航月曆有掛曆與桌曆設計，其中桌曆頁面含括4頁功能頁、放大書寫空間，另新增Q版航空角色和旅行符號貼紙頁，方便使用者自由點綴、標記特殊節日，兼具實用與趣味。
而2027年延續限量贈送形式，即日起陸續發送華夏晶鑽、翡翠會員等；於11月6日至9日參加ITF台灣國際旅展華航攤位現場活動，也有機會獲得。
paras_en: China Airlines (2610‑TW) will welcome a brand‑new 787 aircraft, so the 2027 calendar is themed “Flying Through the Dreamy Moments of the 787.” It highlights the spirit of teamwork, linking the airline’s craftsmanship and service. China Airlines emphasizes that, from multiple perspectives, it records each department’s preparation and dedication for the new plane, conveying the shared mission of the whole team to welcome the 787.

The calendar opens in January with a dawn scene on the apron, featuring pilots, cabin crew, ground staff and maintenance personnel together, showcasing a fresh atmosphere for the new aircraft. February focuses on engines and maintenance details, conveying composure at thirty‑thousand feet born from millimetre‑precise persistence. March and April visit ground‑handling and cargo operations, illustrating careful protection of passenger luggage and valuable cargo. In May the story moves into the cabin, with warm, attentive service, unveiling each month a different 787 cabin space and experience.

In June and July, the designs incorporate Yushan sunrise and Hehuan Mountain mist into the 787 cabin welcome panels, creating an Eastern aesthetic and premium feel. August, September and October each spotlight the premium economy, economy, and premium business cabins respectively. November delves into the cockpit, showing pilots focused on flight and safeguarding every journey. December features a 787 taking off as the sky brightens, symbolising a new chapter of travel ahead.

The 2027 China Airlines calendar will be available as both wall‑hang and desk versions. The desk calendar includes four functional pages with enlarged writing space, plus new chibi‑style airline character and travel‑icon stickers for users to decorate and mark special dates, combining practicality with fun.

The limited‑edition giveaway continues in 2027, with items such as the Huaxia Crystal Diamond and Jade membership cards being distributed from now on. Attendees at China Airlines’ booth at the ITF Taiwan International Travel Fair from November 6‑9 will also have a chance to receive them.

items.title: 〈電商備戰雙11〉經濟成長刺激內需 富邦媒拚全年業績創高
items.title_en: <E‑commerce Prepares for Double 11> Economic Growth Fuels Domestic Demand, Fubon Media Aims for Record Annual Performance
paras: 富邦媒(8454-TW)旗下momo購物網宣布，瞄準即將到來的雙11電商大檔期，攜手逾萬家品牌，讓消費者從家庭補貨、犒賞自己到收藏偶像好禮，都能找到參與雙11的理由，富邦媒總經理谷元宏樂觀期待，今年國內經濟成長創新高，可望帶動雙11買氣也創高，而全年營收和獲利皆朝新高目標努力中。
富邦媒表示，今年雙11活動號召逾萬家品牌共同登場，打造成全民參與的雙11購物嘉年華，由品牌夥伴端出主打商品與限量好禮，momo則整合行銷資源、AI推薦和智慧物流服務，讓好商品遇見更多消費者。
富邦媒總經理谷元宏說，雙11是消費者期待的購物盛事，也是品牌夥伴一年一度展現實力的舞台，momo已將行銷、科技和物流都準備好，不管是幫家裡補貨、買一件想很久的商品，還是揪朋友一起，希望消費者都能滿載而歸，品牌夥伴也有好成績，一起熱熱鬧鬧過雙11。
而另一大電商平台Yahoo購物則指出，在此次雙11大檔推全新對話式購物助理「AI懂買」，全面支援行動網頁與App，讓消費者從「搜尋商品」升級為「對話找商品」，同時，深化和統一集團的uniopen會員生活圈、OPENPOINT點數生態系與實體通路合作，期打造更貼近消費者需求的智慧購物體驗。

富邦媒今年強打(1)11/1及11/10-11/11個人回饋最高3,600、11/10-11/11隊伍消費最高送15,555；(2)邀請韓流天團SUPER JUNIOR-83z利特、希澈擔任大使，推出多項限定周邊活動；(3)單日消費滿5,999元、即可登記999元加購momoBOOK彩色閱讀器；(4)超取99起免運，超取滿千再送30萬份美食；(5) 11/1、11/10-11/11下單抽NISSAN新車；(6)現在訂閱moPro會員，年繳299，全年可拿1,080元mo幣，還有專屬折價券、雙11專屬價商品，及提前登記贈品的專屬時段；(7)加入點點賺會員，把好商品分享給親朋好友購買還有5%到25%的mo幣分潤回饋。
paras_en: Fubon Media (8454‑TW) and its momo shopping platform announced that, targeting the upcoming Double 11 e‑commerce boom, it will partner with more than 10,000 brands so consumers can find reasons to join the event—from restocking household supplies and treating themselves to collecting idol gifts. General Manager Gu Yuan‑hong expressed optimism that this year’s domestic economic growth will hit a new high, likely boosting Double 11 sales, and the company is working toward new peaks in both revenue and profit for the full year.

Fubon Media said the Double 11 campaign this year will feature over 10,000 brands, creating a nationwide shopping carnival. Brand partners will showcase flagship products and limited‑edition gifts, while momo will integrate marketing resources, AI recommendations and smart logistics services to connect great products with more shoppers.

General Manager Gu Yuan‑hong noted that Double 11 is a highly anticipated shopping festival for consumers and an annual stage for brand partners to demonstrate their strength. momo has prepared marketing, technology and logistics, so whether shoppers are restocking at home, buying a long‑desired item, or gathering friends, they can leave fully satisfied and brands can achieve strong results together during the lively Double 11 period.

Yahoo Shopping, another major e‑commerce platform, highlighted its new conversational shopping assistant “AI‑Smart Buy,” which supports both mobile web and app. The tool upgrades the experience from “searching for products” to “conversing to find products,” while deepening integration with the group’s uniopen member ecosystem, OPENPOINT points, and physical‑store collaborations to deliver a smarter shopping experience that’s closer to consumer needs.

Fubon Media’s Double 11 promotions this year include: (1) personal rebates up to NT$3,600 on 11/1 and 11/10‑11/11, and team‑spending rewards up to NT$15,555 on 11/10‑11/11; (2) K‑pop group SUPER JUNIOR‑83z’s Leeteuk and Heechul as ambassadors with exclusive merchandise events; (3) a NT$999 add‑on momoBOOK color e‑reader for single‑day purchases of NT$5,999 or more; (4) free shipping for pickup orders starting at NT$99, plus 300,000 food vouchers for pickup orders over NT$1,000; (5) a draw for a new NISSAN car for orders placed on 11/1 and 11/10‑11/11; (6) moPro membership subscription at NT$299 annually, granting NT$1,080 mo‑coins, exclusive coupons, Double 11‑only pricing, and early‑access gift registration slots; (7) “Point‑Earn” membership that lets users share products with friends and earn 5%‑25% mo‑coin revenue share.

items.title: AI組件訂單出貨激增挹注業績 榮惠將辦現增籌資1.76億元
items.title_en: AI Component Order Shipments Surge, Boosting Performance; Rong Hui Plans Capital Increase of NT$176 Million
paras: AI液冷組件及PCB供應商榮惠-KY(6924-TW)因應業績走揚，擬發行現增股籌資1.76億元，今(30)日獲金管會申報生效。
榮惠-KY擬發行現增股1630張，暫訂每股以108元溢價發行，籌資1.76億元，今天獲金管會申報生效，主辦券商爲中國信託證券。
榮惠-KY 2026年9月營收2.92億元，月增20.45%、年增141倍，第三季營收7.2億元，也改寫歷史新高。主要受惠AI液冷業務進入放量期，CDU（冷卻分配單元）出貨量暢旺，激勵營運向上 ，且在客戶需求強勁之下，2026年第四季營運樂觀。
榮惠-KY主要客戶追加水冷模組與水冷快速接頭（QD）、感應器、PCBA、板金機殼等相關零組件，加上新開發美系客戶出貨量擴大，站穩伺服器產業擴張浪潮。以地區別來看，日本市場受惠記憶體漲價及需求大增營收翻倍，泰國市場車用基板需求強勁，帶動整體營運走強。
劉世璘表示，公司以AI伺服器液冷供應服務商為核心定位，提供客戶FPC、Rigid-flex、Metal及HDI等多種類基板一站式服務的策略。上半年AI伺服器產品營收占比僅8.2％，第三季占比逐步攀升，累計1-9月提升至11.4％。
液冷產品之外，榮惠-KYI在PC及PCB受惠日本、泰國市場車用基板需求強勁，同步挹注營運成長榮惠第二季毛利率成長至23.2，法人認為，隨著第三季營運規模擴大，毛利率等獲利指標值得期待。
榮惠-KY2026年第二季營收5.15億元，毛利率23.2%，季減3.27個百分點，年增1.42個百分點，稅後純益4234萬元，季減9.2%，年增4.09倍，單季每股純益2.05元。榮惠-KY在2026年上半年營收9.87億元，毛利率24.77%，年增4.11個百分點，稅後純益8896萬元，年增1.49倍，每股純益4.31元。
paras_en: AI liquid‑cooling component and PCB supplier Rong Hui‑KY (6924‑TW) is responding to rising performance by planning a cash‑increase share offering to raise NT$176 million, which was approved by the Financial Supervisory Commission today (30th).

Rong Hui‑KY intends to issue 1,630 new shares at a premium of NT$108 per share, targeting a total raise of NT$176 million; the filing became effective today, with China Trust Securities acting as the lead underwriter.

Rong Hui‑KY reported revenue of NT$2.92 billion for September 2026, up 20.45% month‑over‑month and 141‑fold year‑over‑year, and third‑quarter revenue of NT$7.2 billion, a new historical high, driven by AI liquid‑cooling business entering a volume‑expansion phase, strong CDU (cooling distribution unit) shipments, and optimistic outlook for Q4 2026 under robust customer demand.

Key customers of Rong Hui‑KY added water‑cooling modules, quick‑connect water‑cooling fittings (QD), sensors, PCBA, and metal chassis components, while shipments to newly developed U.S. customers expanded, solidifying the company’s position in the server‑industry expansion wave. Regionally, Japan benefited from memory price hikes and surging demand, doubling revenue, and Thailand’s automotive substrate demand remained strong, further bolstering overall performance.

Liu Shilin said the company’s core positioning is as a supplier of AI server liquid‑cooling services, offering a one‑stop solution for customers with FPC, rigid‑flex, metal and HDI substrates. AI server product revenue accounted for only 8.2% in the first half of the year, but rose steadily in the third quarter, reaching 11.4% for the January‑September period.

Beyond liquid‑cooling products, Rong Hui‑KY also benefited from strong automotive substrate demand in Japan and Thailand for PC and PCB, contributing to operational growth; the company’s gross margin rose to 23.2% in Q2, and analysts believe that with the expanded scale in Q3, profit metrics such as gross margin are worth期待 (expected to improve).

Rong Hui‑KY posted Q2 2026 revenue of NT$5.15 billion, gross margin 23.2% (down 3.27 percentage points quarter‑on‑quarter, up 1.42 points year‑on‑year), net profit after tax NT$42.34 million (down 9.2% quarter‑on‑quarter, up 4.09‑fold year‑on‑year), and earnings per share NT$2.05. For the first half of 2026, revenue was NT$9.87 billion, gross margin 24.77% (up 4.11 points year‑on‑year), net profit after tax NT$88.96 million (up 1.49‑fold year‑on‑year), and earnings per share NT$4.31.

items.title: 技嘉簽訂500億元聯貸案 備戰明年AI伺服器購料
items.title_en: Gigabyte Signs NT$50 Billion Syndicated Loan to Prepare for Next Year’s AI Server Material Purchases
paras: PC品牌技嘉(2376-TW)董事會決議通過與聯貸銀行團簽訂總額達500億元的聯合授信合約，用以償還金融機構借款並充實中期營運週轉金，提前替明年度AI產品的購料與備貨需求預作準備。這項聯貸案由臺灣銀行、兆豐銀行、華南銀行及國泰世華銀行共同擔任統籌主辦銀行，整體授信期間自首次動用日起算為期5年。
第四季隨著NVL72機櫃出貨比重回升，單季營收表現預計將進一步超越第三季，下半年的整體成長動能也將明顯勝過上半年。至於板卡與電腦硬體相關業務方面，第四季預估維持與第三季相仿的平穩水準，整體市場基本需求保持穩定。
展望明年度營運表現，技嘉目前已少量交付搭載NVIDIA新一代Vera Rubin架構的相關產品，預計明年上半年在客戶驗證與建置進度推展下放量出貨。既有的Blackwell平台也將持續出貨，由GB300 NVL72逐步轉向新平台，這類產品升級趨勢有望直接拉抬平均銷售單價。
paras_en: The board of PC brand Gigabyte (2376‑TW) approved a syndicated credit agreement with a loan consortium totaling NT$50 billion, to repay existing bank borrowings and bolster mid‑term working capital, and to proactively prepare for material procurement and inventory needs for AI products in the coming year. The loan is coordinated by Bank of Taiwan, Mega Bank, Hua Nan Bank and Cathay United Bank, with the credit facility spanning five years from the first drawdown date.

In the fourth quarter, as the shipment share of the NVL72 chassis rebounds, quarterly revenue is expected to further exceed that of the third quarter, and the overall growth momentum in the second half of the year should clearly outpace the first half. For the board‑level and computer‑hardware related businesses, the fourth‑quarter outlook remains steady and comparable to the third quarter, with basic market demand staying stable.

Looking ahead to next year’s performance, Gigabyte has already delivered a small volume of products featuring NVIDIA’s next‑generation Vera Rubin architecture and expects to ramp up shipments in the first half of next year as customers progress with validation and deployment. The existing Blackwell platform will continue to ship, with a gradual shift from the GB300 NVL72 to the new platform, a product upgrade trend that is expected to directly lift average selling prices.

items.title: 華爾街日報：美國施壓 烏克蘭已暫停攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠
paras: 知情人士透露，烏克蘭軍方已暫停攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠，此前美國總統川普連續數周施壓，動搖了基輔對美國支持的信心。
據《華爾街日報》29日（周四）報導，消息人士說，這次非正式暫停預計將持續到美國國會期中選舉之後，也可能延續至11月更晚。
烏克蘭政府尚未宣布暫停襲擊俄羅斯煉油廠。烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基曾表示，希望本國能源基礎設施得到更多保護，以此作為暫緩打擊的交換條件。在冬季來臨前，俄羅斯一直在通過飛彈和無人機攻擊，系統性摧毀這些設施。
兩名知情軍方官員說，參與遠程打擊的烏克蘭部隊在10月中旬接到通知，在完成已經啟動的任務後，對煉油廠的打擊行動實際上就暫停了。
一名消息人士說，烏克蘭國防部長Evgeniy Khmara告訴澤倫斯基，鑒於外交局勢波譎雲詭，軍方認為最好暫緩攻擊煉油廠。該人士說，澤倫斯基表示可以，但他強調軍方仍可自行決定再次襲擊煉油廠。
談及暫緩打擊煉油廠，澤倫斯基27日在基輔對記者說：「官兵這幾天儘量更謹慎一些，但軍隊並沒有接到『禁打煉油廠』的命令。」 澤倫斯基說，無人機部隊正在攻擊俄羅斯境內不同類型的目標。
儘管川普去年重返白宮時終止了美國對基輔的大部分軍事和財政援助，但烏克蘭對「星鏈」（Starlink）、美國情報共享和「愛國者」飛彈的依賴，仍使其易受美國施壓。
近幾周川普不斷向澤倫斯基施壓，要求停止打擊俄羅斯煉油廠，並將全球燃料價格高漲歸咎於烏克蘭。但能源專家表示，燃料價格走高主要是伊朗戰爭引發。
共和黨候選人擔心，燃料價格可能影響期中選舉選情。川普已放寬對俄羅斯柴油的制裁，以期緩解美國農民等消費者的壓力。

items.title: 台新證打國際盃 找這7家電子業開國際法人閉門會議
items.title_en: Taishin Securities Hosts International Cup, Invites 7 Electronics Companies to Closed-Door Corporate Meeting
paras: 為深化台灣資本市場與國際資金鏈結，台新證券攜手櫃買中心和7家國內優質上櫃企業，赴新加坡盛大舉辦「TPEx & Taishin Taiwan Corporate Day」，與新加坡主權基金、專業投資機構、大型資產管理公司及保險機構等近20家國際法人接觸交流。
本次獲邀赴星的7家績優上櫃企業，包括弘塑(3131-TW)、雙鴻(3324-TW)、臺慶科(3357-TW)、力旺(3529-TW)、家登(3680-TW)、信驊(5274-TW)和台半(5425-TW)，產業範疇橫跨先進封裝濕製程設備、散熱模組、電感元件、嵌入式非揮發性記憶體IP、半導體光罩載具、遠端伺服器管理晶片及功率半導體等關鍵領域。
台新證說明，此次共同參與國內上櫃業者均是全球供應鏈和台灣資本市場極具代表性的領頭羊，透過一對一閉門座談及小型團體會議，有助台灣資本市場國際能見度。
台新證券總經理陳立國認為，全球AI產業加速發展、科技供應鏈持續重組，台灣憑藉完整的半導體及ICT產業聚落，在全球科技供應鏈的戰略地位日益受到國際資本關注，而新加坡兼具東協門戶及國際金融中心優勢，匯聚主權基金、資產管理機構和國際投資資金。
台新證看準新加坡市場的資金動能，正積極推動海外法人交流，協助台灣優質企業與國際投資人建立更直接、深度的溝通管道。
陳立國進一步說明，此次赴星引資，也充分展現台新新光金控跨境、跨業整合綜效，透過台新銀行新加坡分行深耕東南亞市場的在地資源與法人客戶網絡，串聯起證券與銀行多元金融服務能量。
paras_en: To deepen the connection between Taiwan's capital market and international capital flows, Taishin Securities partnered with the OTC Exchange and seven high-quality domestic listed companies to hold a grand "TPEx & Taishin Taiwan Corporate Day" in Singapore, engaging with nearly 20 international institutions such as Singapore sovereign funds, professional investment firms, large asset managers, and insurance companies.

The seven invited high-performing listed companies are Hong Su (3131‑TW), Shuang Hong (3324‑TW), Taiqing Technology (3357‑TW), Li Wang (3529‑TW), Jia Deng (3680‑TW), Xin Hua (5274‑TW) and Taiwan Semiconductor (5425‑TW), covering key sectors including advanced packaging wet‑process equipment, heat‑dissipation modules, inductors, embedded non‑volatile memory IP, semiconductor photomask carriers, remote server management chips, and power semiconductors.

Taishin Securities explained that the participating domestic listed firms are leading representatives of the global supply chain and Taiwan's capital market, and that one‑on‑one closed‑door talks and small‑group meetings will help raise the international visibility of Taiwan's capital market.

Taishin Securities General Manager Chen Liguo said that as the global AI industry accelerates and the tech supply chain continues to restructure, Taiwan's comprehensive semiconductor and ICT ecosystem is gaining increasing strategic importance in the global tech supply chain, attracting international capital attention. Singapore, with its dual role as an ASEAN gateway and international financial hub, gathers sovereign funds, asset managers, and international investment capital.

Taishin Securities sees strong capital momentum in the Singapore market and is actively promoting overseas institutional exchanges to help high‑quality Taiwanese companies establish more direct and deeper communication channels with international investors.

Chen Liguo further noted that this investment‑attraction trip to Singapore also showcases the cross‑border and cross‑industry synergy of Taishin Shin Kong Financial Holding, leveraging the local resources and corporate client network of Taishin Bank's Singapore branch in Southeast Asia to link the securities and banking divisions' diversified financial services.

items.title_en: Realtek (2379) Q3 Gross Margin Rebounds to 47.4% – Networking Drives Growth, PC Decline and Memory Costs Pose Risks
paras: 2026年10月30日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 瑞昱第三季營收377.32億元，連兩季創單季新高，毛利率也從第二季47.0%谷底回升至47.4%，反映漲價與高階產品組合改善開始發酵。
不過，PC需求疲弱、記憶體與封測成本上漲，仍是獲利壓力。
接下來營運成長將更仰賴網通規格升級與新應用布局。

漲價效益開始反映，毛利率谷底回升
瑞昱第三季營收377.32億元，季增0.5%、年增27.9%，EPS 8.05元；前三季營收1,117.07億元，年增15.85%。

公司自6月起與客戶協商調價，部分Wi-Fi及高速乙太網路晶片漲幅超過一成，新價格第三季陸續生效。
不過，記憶體與封測成本持續上升，仍可能壓縮後續毛利率。

網通撐起營運，PC需求持續疲弱
第三季網通相關產品成為主要成長動能，多千兆乙太網路已占乙太網路營收超過40%，管理型交換器也持續拓展企業與伺服器市場。
相較之下，PC營收占比已從去年同期33%降至約30%。
Wi-Fi 7滲透率雖持續提升，但全球PC市場需求疲弱，法人預估2027年出貨量仍將下滑，短期難以成為主要成長引擎。

車用、光通訊與AI布局，瞄準長期成長
新應用方面，車用乙太網路新車滲透率已超過50%，相關晶片持續取得設計導入；100G光學PHY正與客戶驗證，預期2027年開始較明顯放量，400G、800G方案則規劃於2027年下半年推出。
此外，瑞昱也布局AI伺服器高速互連與人形機器人，目前HPC及邊緣AI相關營收占比已達高個位數，目標2030年提升至30%以上。

庫存升高，2027年仍要留意成本壓力
第三季庫存週轉天數升至136天，主要是為確保供貨而增加已知良品晶粒庫存。
公司預期第四季雖是傳統淡季，但可望受惠ASP提升與產品組合改善，維持穩定動能。
整體而言，瑞昱已逐步透過調價與網通產品升級改善獲利，但PC需求疲弱、記憶體成本上升及庫存增加仍是風險。
2027年能否延續成長，關鍵在於網通能否持續抵銷PC衰退，以及新應用能否開始貢獻營收。

Going forward, operating growth will rely even more on networking specification upgrades and new application deployments.

Price‑increase benefits are beginning to show, with the gross‑margin trough rebounding. Realtek’s Q3 revenue was NT$37.732 billion, up 0.5% sequentially and 27.9% year‑over‑year, with EPS of NT$8.05; the first three quarters totalled NT$111.707 billion, a 15.85% annual increase.

Nevertheless, memory and wafer‑testing costs continue to climb, which could still compress future gross margins.

Networking underpins operations while PC demand stays weak. In Q3, networking‑related products became the main growth driver, with multi‑gigabit Ethernet now accounting for over 40% of Ethernet revenue, and managed switches continuing to expand in enterprise and server markets.
By contrast, PC revenue share fell from 33% a year ago to about 30%.

Automotive, optical communications and AI initiatives target long‑term growth. The company expects Q4, although traditionally a slow season, to benefit from higher ASPs and an improved product mix, maintaining stable momentum.
Overall, Realtek is gradually improving profitability through price adjustments and networking product upgrades, but weak PC demand, rising memory costs and higher inventory remain risks.

items.title: Google搜尋業務失速後換亞馬遜零售業！科技巨頭搖錢樹接連踢鐵板 現金流惡化引發拋售潮
paras: 正當投資市場圍繞人工智慧(AI)打轉時，拼命砸錢擴張的科技巨頭卻接連在核心業務上踢到鐵板：亞馬遜(AMZN-US)賴以成名的零售業務表現不如預期，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)問題則是出在搜尋業務成長放緩，兩者股價都因此暴跌。

Alphabet搜尋和廣告業務疲弱、現金缺口擴大

Alphabet周四終場狂瀉12.3%至每股282.32美元，創下上市以來最慘財報後表現。該公司第3季自由現金流為負90.7億美元，顯示現金缺口在第2季首度出現之後進一步擴大，而且遠低於分析師預估的負27億美元。
Alphabet周三公布的財報顯示，攸關AI發展的Google Cloud表現亮眼，營收較去年同期倍增，遠優於市場預期，營業利益率達38%，比華爾街共識預估高出2.3個百分點。
但核心的Google搜尋與YouTube廣告業務卻表現疲弱，
而且自由現金流連兩季為負，缺口從第2季的59億美元擴大至91億美元，遠遜於分析師預估的27億美元。

亞馬遜零售與廣告業務遜色、現金流連三季為負

亞馬遜公布財報後，周四(29日)盤後一度下挫逾7%，在公布財報前，亞馬遜股價今年來累計上漲5.6%。
財報顯示，亞馬遜第3季每股獲利1.89美元，低於去年同期的1.95美元和分析師預估的1.97美元。淨銷售額年增12%至2,019億美元，略低於華爾街預估的2,022億美元。
主力的零售業務成長正在放緩：北美部門第3季銷售額年增6%至1,129億美元，低於市場所估的1,132億美元，國際部門銷售額年增5%至431億美元，也比市場預期少約5億美元。
在廣告業務方面，與Google類似，亞馬遜也顯露疲態，年增率從前一季的26%放緩至12%。
目前還無法期待亞馬遜的業績能立即回溫，因為該公司對第4季的財測同樣令人失望：亞馬遜預估本季營業利益中值為310億美元，遠低於分析師預期的332億美元。

AWS成長強勁 雲端業務仍是亮點

攸關AI隸屬的雲端業務仍是亮點，亞馬遜網路服務(AWS)第3季營收年增39%至460億美元，優於分析師預期。
但AWS也並非毫無問題。AI資料中心興建成本使亞馬遜連續三季的自由現金流為負。此外，亞馬遜維持2026年資本支出預估在2,200億美元不變，這是投資人現階段最關注的財務指標之一。
Direxion資本市場主管Jake Behan表示：「AWS成長加速，讓AI投資更容易獲得合理解釋，但不代表成本就此消失。資料中心建置仍使自由現金流承受重大壓力。」

Anthropic為AWS帶來風險

市場也正高度關注AWS因Anthropic面臨的風險。Anthropic本周一公布首次公開發行(IPO)公開說明書，提及亞馬遜及AWS共166次，而且Anthropic也是AWS近期業績表現的重要推動力，AWS成長率開始加速的時間點，恰好與Anthropic銷售額激增相吻合。
亞馬遜與Anthropic的關係相當複雜：亞馬遜既是競爭對手，也是經銷商、客戶及供應商。Anthropic上市後，亞馬遜還將成為持股逾5%的股東。
其中最大的風險，在於Anthropic與AWS簽訂的10年期、總額1,100億美元合約，然而這還只是Anthropic與多家雲端服務商簽訂的眾多合約之一。
當亞馬遜、Alphabet、微軟(MSFT-US)、SpaceX(SPCX-US)、超微(AMD-US)、博通(AVGO-US)、Nscale及Lambda都寄望Anthropic未來有能力支付龐大帳單，一旦Anthropic陷入困境，連鎖效應便可能接連發生。

items.title: 比特幣跌破7.8萬美元！幣安疑遭駭客攻擊 Circle、Tether凍結25.4億美元資金
items.title_en: Bitcoin Falls Below $78,000! Binance Suspected Hack Prompts Circle and Tether to Freeze $2.54 Billion
paras: 比特幣(BTC)周五(30日)跌破7.8萬美元，市場擔憂加密貨幣交易所幣安(Binance)疑似發現資安漏洞，整體事件撼動數位資產市場，並促使包括穩定幣發行商Circle(CRCL-US)與Tether(USDT)在內的多家加密貨幣業者凍結與疑似事件相關的資金，合計達25.4億美元。
比特幣下跌逾4%，報77,994.96美元。這個市值最大加密貨幣周二跌破重要心理關卡8萬美元之後，跌勢進一步擴大。
市值第二大的加密貨幣以太幣(ETH)下跌4.84%，報2,247.45美元。幣安原生代幣BNB重挫7.68%，報694.45美元。
不過Hyperliquid的HYPE代幣逆勢上漲9.7%，報89.08美元，與整體市場跌勢背道而馳。

Circle、Tether聯手凍結25.4億美元資金

多家加密貨幣業者周四凍結與這起疑似事件有關的資金，合計達25.4億美元。
Circle執行長Jeremy Allaire表示，已凍結超過8億美元的美元穩定幣USDC。Tether執行長Paolo Ardoino則表示，已停止涉及超過15億美元USDT的交易，這些資金可能與幣安的資安漏洞有關。
幣安共同創辦人何一表示，Ripple(XRP)也協助阻止2億美元、與這起疑似攻擊事件有關的資金轉移。
區塊鏈分析公司Arkham Intelligence辨識出55個錢包地址，其中持有的數位資產總額近60億美元，可能與這起事件有關。這顯示，疑似資安事件的規模可能遠大於目前遭凍結的資金。

幣安尚未證實遭駭客攻擊

幣安尚未明確證實發生駭客攻擊，僅表示正在調查有關潛在資安問題的通報。該公司發言人表示，「我們的團隊已注意到有關潛在資安問題的通報，目前正積極調查」，並補充，使用者資金仍然安全。
幣安創辦人兼前執行長趙長鵬也試圖安撫投資人，強調客戶資金安全，但他表示，這起事件看起來像是駭客攻擊。
然而，這起事件再度喚起市場對加密貨幣產業資安漏洞的疑慮：2025年，加密貨幣交易所Bybit遭駭客攻擊，損失約15億美元。而不久前，另一家交易所Bitget也因網路竊盜損失超過3.5億美元的數位資產。
paras_en: Bitcoin (BTC) fell below $78,000 on Friday (the 30th) as market worries grew over a possible security breach at crypto exchange Binance, shaking the digital‑asset market and prompting several crypto firms, including stable‑coin issuers Circle (CRCL‑US) and Tether (USDT), to freeze funds linked to the incident, totalling $2.54 billion.
Bitcoin dropped more than 4% to $77,994.96. The market‑cap‑largest cryptocurrency, after breaking the key psychological barrier of $80,000 on Tuesday, saw its decline accelerate further.
The second‑largest cryptocurrency, Ether (ETH), fell 4.84% to $2,247.45, while Binance’s native token BNB plunged 7.68% to $694.45.
However, Hyperliquid’s HYPE token rose 9.7% to $89.08, moving opposite to the broader market trend.
Circle and Tether jointly froze $2.54 billion in funds. Several crypto firms on Thursday froze money they said was related to the suspected incident, amounting to a total of $2.54 billion.

Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire said the firm has frozen more than $800 million worth of USDC stablecoins. Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said it has halted transactions involving over $1.5 billion of USDT, which may be tied to Binance’s security breach.
Binance co‑founder He Yi said Ripple (XRP) also helped block $200 million of fund transfers linked to the suspected attack.

Blockchain analytics firm Arkham Intelligence identified 55 wallet addresses holding nearly $6 billion in digital assets that may be connected to the event, suggesting the breach’s scale could be far larger than the frozen amount.

Binance has not confirmed a hack. The exchange said it is investigating reports of a potential security issue, with a spokesperson noting, “Our team is aware of the reports and is actively investigating,” and adding that user funds remain safe.
Binance founder and former CEO Zhao Changpeng also tried to reassure investors, emphasizing the safety of client funds, but he said the incident appears to be a hacking attempt.

The episode revives market concerns over security flaws in the crypto industry: in 2025, exchange Bybit was hacked, losing about $1.5 billion, and not long ago, another exchange, Bitget, suffered a cyber‑theft of over $350 million in digital assets.

items.title: 疑似遭駭客攻擊！全球最大加密貨幣交易所幣安凍資約30億美元 比特幣跌破7.9萬美元
items.title_en: Possible Hack! Binance, the World’s Largest Crypto Exchange, Freezes About $3 Billion; Bitcoin Falls Below $79,000
paras: 全球最大加密貨幣交易所幣安(Binance)疑遭史上最大規模駭客攻擊，正緊急調查並凍結相關資產，並證實目前已凍結約30億美元資產，且數字可能隨追蹤進度繼續攀升。該交易所還強調，尚無法確認用戶資金受影響，用戶資產安全為當前優先處理事項。
事件引爆市場恐慌。周四下午，幣安用戶錢包一度流出逾57億美元資產，比特幣價格應聲重挫3.7%，跌破7.9萬美元，創9月來新低，其他加密貨幣同步遭到拋售。
目前，幣安已暫停提幣及幣安Alpha交易，並會同執法部門、代幣發行方、區塊鏈情報公司與業界夥伴追查資金流向。
幣安發言人表示，安全團隊正緊急審查所有相關資訊，僅會在官方渠道公布經核實據，外界流傳的18億美元等不同版本，均非最終確認口徑。
幣安共同創辦人趙長鵬(CZ)在X平台上指出，交易所「似乎遭到駭客攻擊」，並預期若確認損失，所有用戶資金將獲全額賠付；他雖已退出日常營運，仍是幣安最大股東。
區塊鏈追蹤平台Arkham已識別出與疑似駭客相關錢包，持倉約59億美元，但該數字不等同於實際盜走金額。分析師與交易員推估，本次潛在被盜規模介於17億至57億美元之間。
這起事件發生於所謂的「黑色十月」期間，近期一連串高調網攻與AI發現的漏洞，令市場憂心全球性加密危機。加密交易公司JPEG Trading聯合創始人Kevin March直言：「這是前所未見的。」
paras_en: The world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange Binance is suspected of suffering the biggest hack in history and is urgently investigating while freezing related assets. It has confirmed that roughly $3 billion worth of assets have been frozen so far, and the figure may rise as the investigation proceeds. The exchange emphasized that it cannot yet confirm any impact on user funds, and safeguarding user assets is the top priority.

The incident sparked market panic. On Thursday afternoon, more than $5.7 billion flowed out of Binance users’ wallets, prompting Bitcoin to plunge 3.7% and slip below $79,000, a September low, while other cryptocurrencies were sold off in tandem.

Binance has temporarily halted withdrawals and Binance Alpha trading, and is working with law‑enforcement agencies, token issuers, blockchain intelligence firms and industry partners to trace the flow of funds.

A Binance spokesperson said the security team is urgently reviewing all related information and will only publish verified data through official channels. Various unverified figures circulating in the media, such as $1.8 billion, are not the final confirmed amount.

Binance co‑founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) posted on X that the exchange “appears to have been hacked” and said that if losses are confirmed, all user funds will be fully compensated; although he has stepped back from day‑to‑day operations, he remains the largest shareholder.

Blockchain tracking platform Arkham has identified wallets linked to the suspected hackers holding about $5.9 billion, but this does not equal the amount actually stolen. Analysts and traders estimate the potential theft to be between $1.7 billion and $5.7 billion.

The incident occurred during the so‑called “Black October” period, a string of high‑profile cyber‑attacks and AI‑discovered vulnerabilities that have raised concerns of a global crypto crisis. Kevin March, co‑founder of crypto trading firm JPEG Trading, bluntly said: “This is unprecedented.”

items.title: 星巴克在中國推「消費入座」後 宜家、霸王茶姬等品牌有門市試點
items.title_en: Starbucks Launches “Consume to Sit” in China; IKEA, BaWang Tea House and Others Pilot the Policy
paras: 近日星巴克(SBUX-US) 在全中國門市啟動「消費入座」倡議，商家消費空間與座位資源該如何管理引發關注，目前多個品牌門市出現類似「消費入座」提示。
近日有中國網友反映，上海徐匯宜家餐廳開始實行「消費入座」，周二、周四還有保安勸離佔座的消費者。
宜家上海徐匯商場對此表示，餐廳內出現了長時間佔座、喧譁、食用自帶食物等非用餐行為，一定程度上影響了部分顧客正常就餐，採取每周二和周四「用餐就座」引導，是希望確保座位資源能更好地服務於有實際用餐需求的顧客。
中國其餘宜家商場餐廳還沒有同步出現同類措施。
據《界面新聞》29日（周四）報導，一些茶飲品牌的門市也採取了類似提示。有網友發帖，稱在霸王茶姬山東臨沂某個門市看到桌上擺放了「消費入座」的標識。
霸王茶姬青島萬象城店工作人員29日表示，該門市執行「消費入座」的規則，此前提示牌被顧客弄掉了，正在重新製作。門市工作人員稱，提示主要針對長期佔位、自帶外賣佔座的情況，彈性執行，短暫進店歇腳的消費者不會被勸離。
另外，還有成都消費者在網上曬出24日拍到一家奈雪的茶(02150-HK) 門市「消費入座」提示牌，不過她說自己在店內停留約30分鐘，有未消費顧客就座，店員並未提醒或勸離。
奈雪的茶客服熱線人員對此回應：總部沒「消費入座」相關規定，門市可根據經營需要自行決定。
瑞幸、庫迪、喜茶、Manner、Tims、麥當勞(MCD-US) 、肯德基等品牌，總部均未有明確消費入座統一政策。
對於商家推行「消費入座」，不少消費者表示支持，門市有控制營運成本、保障付費顧客權益的合理訴求，如果過多未消費顧客佔用消費顧客空間，對門市消費者來講也不公平。
paras_en: Starbucks (SBUX-US) has recently rolled out a “consume to sit” initiative across all its stores in China, sparking discussion about how merchants should manage dining space and seating resources, and prompting similar signage at several other brand locations.

A Chinese netizen reported that IKEA’s restaurant in Shanghai’s Xuhui store has begun enforcing “consume to sit,” with security staff on Tuesdays and Thursdays asking customers who are occupying seats without ordering to leave.

IKEA’s Xuhui Shanghai mall explained that the restaurant has seen prolonged seat‑holding, noise, and customers eating food they brought in, which to some extent disrupts other diners; the Tuesday and Thursday “dine‑and‑sit” guidance aims to ensure seats are better used by those with genuine dining needs.
Other IKEA restaurant locations in China have not yet adopted the same measures.

According to a report by Jiemian News on Thursday the 29th, some tea‑drink brands have also posted similar notices; a netizen said they saw a “consume to sit” sign on a table at a BaWang Tea House outlet in Linyi, Shandong.

Staff at BaWang Tea House’s Qingdao Wanxiang City store said on the 29th that the outlet is enforcing the “consume to sit” rule, that a previous sign had been knocked down by a customer and is being remade, and that the notice mainly targets long‑term seat‑holding and customers bringing in take‑away food, while casual short‑term visitors will not be asked to leave.

In addition, a consumer in Chengdu posted a photo taken on the 24th of a “consume to sit” sign at a Naixue’s Tea (02150-HK) store, but said she stayed about 30 minutes, saw non‑paying customers seated, and was not reminded or asked to leave by staff.
A Naixue’s Tea customer‑service representative replied that the headquarters has no “consume to sit” policy, leaving each store free to decide based on its operational needs.
Brands such as Luckin Coffee, Kudi, Heytea, Manner, Tim Hortons, McDonald’s (MCD-US) and KFC have no unified “consume to sit” policy from their headquarters.

Many consumers support the “consume to sit” practice, noting that it helps stores control operating costs and protect the rights of paying customers; excessive occupation of seating by non‑paying patrons is seen as unfair to those who are actually buying.

items.title: 星巴克Q4營收、國際銷售不如預期 盤後股價轉跌
items.title_en: Starbucks Q4 Revenue and International Sales Miss Expectations; After-Hours Stock Falls
paras: 星巴克(Starbucks)(SBUX-US) 週四(29日)公布的第四季財報好壞參半，儘管同店銷售明顯成長，但營收及國際市場銷售不及預期，盤後股價轉跌，公司正尋求逐步走出轉型計畫，進一步加速成長。
據《Yahoo Finance》報導，這家咖啡巨頭連續第五季公布優於預期的同店銷售成長，增幅達 7.2%，高於華爾街預估的 6.2%。成長主要由美國市場帶動，當地銷售額增加 7.7%。其中，平均客單價約成長 5%，反映顧客在星巴克的消費金額提高，交易筆數則增加約 2%。
執行長 Brian Niccol 表示，「我們有明確的計畫，一直按照計畫推進，而且計畫正在發揮作用。」他補充，公司「營運表現更加穩定一致」，到星巴克消費的顧客也越來越多。
第四季調整後每股盈餘(EPS)為 0.80 美元，高於華爾街預估的 0.71 美元。不過，營收未達預期，為 91 億美元，低於市場預估的 92 億美元，反映星巴克出售中國業務的影響。
國際市場銷售表現也不如華爾街預期，僅成長 0.9%，低於市場原先預估的約 3%。
這份財報也公布了星巴克 2026 會計年度的全年業績，整體表現呈現類似情況：營收低於市場預估，但獲利與同店銷售成長則優於預期。
全年營收成長 2%，達 379 億美元，略低於市場預期的 380 億美元。調整後每股盈餘年增 28%，達 2.72 美元，高於市場預估的 2.62 美元。
全年全球同店銷售成長 6.2%，高於市場預估的 6%，成長動能同樣主要來自北美業務。
Niccol 表示，「我們以成長動能、明確的優先事項，以及對星巴克未來發展更高的期許，進入 2027 會計年度。」
本月稍早，市場傳出星巴克正與 Chipotle 洽談收購事宜。不過，星巴克已於 10 月初澄清相關傳聞，而 Chipotle 的財報電話會議中也未提及此事。
星巴克發言人當時表示，「依照公司政策，我們不會評論傳聞與猜測，但我們希望明確澄清，我們沒有要收購 Chipotle。」
paras_en: Starbucks (SBUX-US) released its fourth‑quarter earnings on Thursday (the 29th) with mixed results: while comparable store sales grew markedly, revenue and international market sales fell short of expectations, causing the stock to dip in after‑hours trading as the company seeks to gradually emerge from its transformation plan and further accelerate growth.

According to Yahoo Finance, the coffee giant posted its fifth consecutive quarter of comparable store sales growth, expanding 7.2% versus Wall Street’s forecast of 6.2%. The growth was driven mainly by the U.S. market, where sales rose 7.7%. Average ticket size grew about 5%, reflecting higher spend per customer, while transaction counts rose roughly 2%.

Chief Executive Brian Niccol said, “We have a clear plan, we’ve been executing it consistently, and the plan is delivering.” He added that the company’s “operating performance is becoming more stable and consistent,” and that more customers are visiting Starbucks.

Adjusted earnings per share for the quarter were $0.80, above Wall Street’s estimate of $0.71. However, revenue missed expectations at $9.1 billion, below the market forecast of $9.2 billion, reflecting the impact of Starbucks’ sale of its China business.
International market sales also lagged Wall Street expectations, growing only 0.9% versus the roughly 3% analysts had projected.
The report also disclosed full‑year results for fiscal 2026, which showed a similar pattern: revenue fell short of forecasts, while profit and comparable store sales outperformed expectations.
Full‑year revenue grew 2% to $37.9 billion, slightly below the market outlook of $38.0 billion. Adjusted EPS rose 28% year‑over‑year to $2.72, beating the consensus estimate of $2.62.
Global comparable store sales for the year increased 6.2%, topping the 6% forecast, with growth momentum again coming primarily from the North American business.
Niccol said, “We are entering fiscal 2027 with growth momentum, clear priorities, and higher expectations for Starbucks’ future.”

Earlier this month, rumors circulated that Starbucks was in talks to acquire Chipotle. Starbucks clarified the speculation in early October, and Chipotle’s earnings call did not mention any such discussion.
A Starbucks spokesperson said at the time, “In accordance with company policy, we do not comment on rumors or speculation, but we want to make it clear that we have no intention to acquire Chipotle.”

items.title: AWS喊出明後年都成長逾40% 亞馬遜2027年資本支出再擴大
items.title_en: AWS Forecasts Over 40% Growth in 2027-2028, Amazon Expands 2027 Capital Expenditure
paras: 2026年10月30日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)29日公布第3季財報，雲端部門AWS營收年增39.3%，連續第6季加速成長，創近5年新高。執行長Andy Jassy也首度給出遠期目標：AWS 2027、2028年每年營收成長都將超過40%，5到10年內營收規模上看1兆美元。不過市場的焦點落在龐大的資本支出上，股價盤後下跌約7.3%。
這次賣壓和近期其他AI股遭拋售的原因相同。亞馬遜第3季現金資本支出達759億美元，自由現金流轉為負數，第4季營業利益財測285億至335億美元也被市場認為偏保守。
從法說會內容來看，AWS的需求其實沒有降溫跡象。AWS年化營收規模達1840億美元，未完成訂單5780億美元，比去年同期成長1倍以上。Jassy形容，平均每14秒裝好一顆AI加速器，產能幾乎一上線就被客戶用掉。他說，客戶動輒預訂數百MW甚至1GW的大型產能，必須提前好幾年簽約，因此公司對未來2到3年的需求有很好的能見度。
需求吃緊也反映在價格上。上一代Trainium晶片的短期租用價格比上半年更高，上一代Graviton處理器的未完成訂單也季增1倍以上。AI需求的重心正轉向推論，推論已佔AWS AI營收一半以上；推論服務Bedrock的token使用量年增近17倍，而且大部分跑在自研的Trainium晶片上。
要支撐這樣的成長，資本支出只會更高。亞馬遜今年資本支出約2200億美元，Jassy表示明年將明顯增加。他坦言，如果這波需求能分攤在25年慢慢投資會比較輕鬆，但機會不等人。自研晶片也將在2027年底開始對外銷售，但各家大廠都向同一家晶圓代工廠下單，能分到的產能有限，對外賣多少、留給自家雲端用多少，必須每年權衡。
市場另一個疑慮是利潤率。AWS第3季營業利益率38.7%，但財務長Brian Olsavsky沒有承諾能維持這個水準。他提到三個壓力：AI業務利潤率仍低於核心雲端，AI比重越高，整體利潤率越受壓；記憶體等零組件價格上漲；新產品導入初期的成本。Jassy則強調，亞馬遜大部分資料中心是自有或長期租賃，加上使用自研晶片，成本結構比租用NeoCloud產能的同業更有優勢。
零售業務同樣表現穩健。今年以來零售出貨件數年增近15%，公司整體營業利益率達13.9%，創歷史新高。亞馬遜預估第4季營收2400億至2470億美元。

paras_en: On October 30, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Amazon (AMZN-US) announced its Q3 earnings on the 29th, showing AWS revenue up 39.3% year‑over‑year, marking the sixth consecutive quarter of accelerating growth and a near‑five‑year high. CEO Andy Jassy also gave a long‑term target for the first time: AWS revenue will grow more than 40% each year in 2027 and 2028, with a scale of about $1 trillion within 5‑10 years. However, the market’s focus is on the massive capital spending, and the stock fell about 7.3% after hours.

The sell‑off this time mirrors recent AI‑stock sell‑downs. Amazon’s Q3 cash capital expenditures reached $75.9 billion, turning free cash flow negative, and the forecast for Q4 operating profit of $28.5 billion to $33.5 billion was seen by the market as conservative.

From the earnings call, AWS demand shows no sign of cooling. AWS’s annualized revenue reaches $184 billion, with unfilled orders of $578 billion, more than double year‑over‑year. Jassy described that on average an AI accelerator is installed every 14 seconds, and capacity is almost instantly consumed by customers. He said customers routinely pre‑order hundreds of megawatts to even 1 GW of large‑scale capacity, requiring contracts signed several years in advance, giving the company good visibility into demand for the next two to three years.

Tight demand is also reflected in pricing. Short‑term rental prices for the previous‑generation Trainium chip are higher than in the first half of the year, and unfilled orders for the previous‑generation Graviton processors have more than doubled quarter‑over‑quarter. AI demand is shifting toward inference, which now accounts for more than half of AWS AI revenue; inference service Bedrock’s token usage grew almost 17‑fold year‑over‑year, and most of it runs on Amazon’s own Trainium chips.

To support this growth, capital spending will only rise. Amazon’s capital expenditures this year are about $220 billion, and Jassy said next year’s spending will increase noticeably. He admitted that spreading this wave of demand over a longer period, such as through 2025, would ease the investment burden, but the opportunity won’t wait. The in‑house chips will also start external sales by the end of 2027, but all major players order from the same foundry, limiting available capacity; each year the company must balance how much to sell externally versus retain for its own cloud.

Another market concern is profitability. AWS’s Q3 operating margin was 38.7%, but CFO Brian Olsavsky did not promise to maintain that level. He cited three pressures: AI business margins remain lower than core cloud, and a higher AI share drags overall margins; rising component prices such as memory; and costs associated with introducing new products. Jassy emphasized that most of Amazon’s data centers are owned or long‑term leased, and using its own chips gives a cost structure advantage over peers that rent NeoCloud capacity.

The retail segment also performed solidly. Year‑to‑date retail shipments grew nearly 15% year‑over‑year, and the company’s overall operating margin reached 13.9%, a historic high. Amazon forecasts Q4 revenue of $240 billion to $247 billion.

items.title: 〈分析〉Trainium擬2027年走出AWS：亞馬遜AI晶片下一步怎麼賺？
items.title_en: Analysis: Trainium Aims to Exit AWS by 2027 – How Amazon Will Monetize Its AI Chip Next
paras: 亞馬遜 (Amazon) (AMZN-US) 自研AI晶片Trainium準備跨出AWS生態系，下一步不只是擴大晶片使用量，更牽涉一門新的商業模式：究竟要直接出售晶片與伺服器、透過其他雲端平台提供運算服務，還是採取不同形式的合作？這些選擇將決定亞馬遜能從強勁的晶片需求中創造多少收入，以及必須承擔多少硬體投資與現金流壓力。

亞馬遜執行長賈西 (Andy Jassy) 周四 (29日) 在第三季財報電話會議上表示，隨著Trainium需求強勁，客戶也持續要求將這款自研AI晶片開放至AWS以外的環境，公司計畫在2027年底讓Trainium「在AWS之外可用」。不過，賈西並未說明具體交易形式，也沒有公布合作對象、供應規模或定價方式。這項計畫目前能確認的是Trainium將擴大AWS以外的使用範圍，並不代表亞馬遜已決定直接向客戶出售晶片。
目前Trainium主要透過AWS雲端執行個體 (instance) 提供，客戶向AWS租用運算資源，而不是直接購買晶片。若未來改採硬體銷售，亞馬遜可能需要承擔晶片製造、伺服器組裝、庫存及交付成本；若透過其他雲端平台提供使用權，則可能擴大客戶觸及範圍，但仍須釐清硬體由誰持有、誰負責部署，以及亞馬遜如何從合作中收取費用。交易形式不同，對營收認列、資本支出與利潤率的影響也會截然不同。
Trainium走向外部市場的背景，是亞馬遜自研晶片與AI雲端服務需求同步升溫。亞馬遜7月曾揭露，AI雲端業務與晶片業務的年化營收均已超過250億美元，且都維持三位數年增幅。賈西周四進一步透露，上一代Trainium執行個體的短期產能已供不應求，售價高於今年上半年，顯示客戶對現有運算資源的需求相當強勁。
AWS第三季營收達459.8億美元，年增39.3%，換算年化營收規模約1,840億美元；AWS整體積壓訂單 (backlog) 則達5,780億美元，年增幅達三位數。不過，這筆積壓訂單涵蓋AWS整體雲端業務，亞馬遜並未單獨揭露Trainium的訂單規模，因此不能直接將AWS積壓訂單視為Trainium的潛在收入。
亞馬遜也持續強化自研晶片的成本優勢。賈西表示，第三季採用亞馬遜自研晶片的客戶，累計節省超過20億美元成本。公司推出Graviton 5處理器後，前一代Graviton執行個體的積壓訂單較前一季增加逾一倍；Graviton相較於x86替代方案，價格效能可提升30%至40%。亞馬遜並開源TorchNeuron，讓開發者能在Trainium上執行PyTorch程式碼，不必大幅改寫原有程式。
在AI服務方面，AWS推論業務營收已占AWS AI營收逾一半，且仍持續成長。賈西認為，未來客戶不會只依賴單一AI模型，而是會根據不同工作負載選擇適合的模型。他預期，未來兩至三年內，市場可能出現6至8個具競爭力、足以滿足95%以上工作負載需求的模型。AWS Bedrock生成式AI服務也有機會成長至與EC2相當的規模，讓亞馬遜不只從晶片本身獲利，也能透過雲端運算、模型部署及推論服務創造更多收入。

不過，Trainium若要走出AWS，Google TPU的外部供應經驗提供了重要參照。Google母公司Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 已開始將自研張量處理器 (TPU) 推向外部市場。《路透社》報導，Google對外銷售TPU系統已帶來數十億美元收入，但這種模式也伴隨硬體投資與現金回收的時間差。尚未售出的TPU系統必須先列入存貨，代表Google需要在客戶付款前投入硬體成本；Alphabet財務長艾許肯納吉 (Anat Ashkenazi) 也表示，既有TPU合約收入大部分要到2027年才會認列。
獲利能力方面，TD Cowen估計，Google TPU銷售業務的營業利益率約20%，低於Google Cloud整體約35%的水準。Alphabet尚未單獨公布TPU營收與利潤率，因此這些數字仍屬分析師估算，不能視為公司正式財務指引。這也凸顯硬體銷售與雲端服務的差異：即使外部需求強勁，供應商仍須先承擔硬體成本，並面對備貨、交付與收款之間的資金落差。
另一種模式則是讓自研晶片登上其他雲端平台。Alphabet周二 (27日) 宣布，甲骨文 (Oracle) (ORCL-US) 將自2027年起，讓Oracle Cloud客戶使用Google TPU。這是Google TPU首度登上Google以外的超大規模雲端平台。Google也已從第二季起向外部資料中心開放TPU，擴大晶片的使用場景。

不過，Google與甲骨文之間的供應條件並未公開，包括TPU究竟以出售、出租或其他合作形式提供，外界仍無法判斷雙方各自承擔多少資本支出，以及Google如何回收硬體投資。Google Cloud執行長庫里安 (Thomas Kurian) 曾表示，Google的AI伺服器不到兩年即可回本，而採用自家晶片的伺服器，回本時間約可再縮短一半。這顯示自研晶片除了降低運算成本，也可能改善資料中心投資的回收效率，但實際效益仍取決於設備利用率、客戶合約與供應條件。

Anthropic的採購布局則反映大型AI業者對多種晶片架構的需求。Anthropic周一提交的上市申請文件顯示，公司同時使用Google、亞馬遜、輝達 (NVIDIA) (NVDA-US) 及超微 (AMD) (AMD-US) 的晶片，依照不同工作負載選擇成本與效能較合適的產品。文件並披露，Anthropic承諾在2026年4月至2033年7月期間，投入1,145億美元採購Google算力資源。這是長期採購承諾，不代表Google已在相關期間認列相同金額的收入，也不能將全部金額直接視為TPU營收。
此前市場也傳出Anthropic擴大採用Google TPU的規模，並與Google及其他供應商洽談大量算力資源。這類需求顯示，AI模型業者正積極尋找輝達GPU以外的替代方案，透過多晶片供應商策略降低成本與供應風險。對亞馬遜而言，若Trainium能在AWS之外取得更多客戶，將有機會把原本綁定自家雲端平台的晶片技術，轉化為更廣泛的外部市場收入。

Google TPU的營收潛力也受到華爾街關注。瑞穗預估，Google TPU營收可能從2026年的280億美元，增加至2027年的670億美元，並於2028年達到1,000億美元。TD Cowen的估算更為樂觀，預測2028年TPU營收可達1,380億美元，約合184兆韓元，相當於Google Cloud營收的34%。這些數字均為分析師預測，並非Alphabet公布的營收目標，也不代表Google已確認所有外部供應合約。
對亞馬遜來說，Trainium外部供應的商業模式尤其重要，因為公司正處於資本支出快速擴張階段。亞馬遜過去12個月自由現金流為流出423.6億美元，與前一年同期仍有147.9億美元流入形成明顯反差；今年資本支出預計約2,200億美元，賈西並表示2027年支出將「大幅高於」今年。公司持續投資資料中心、晶片與AI基礎設施，雖然有助於掌握長期需求，但也使現金流與投資回收速度成為市場關注焦點。
賈西在財報電話會議上強調，AWS採取的是長期平台策略，與主要代管GPU、出租短期資料中心產能的模式不同，並表示公司資本支出的回收速度持續加快。這代表亞馬遜希望透過晶片、雲端平台、AI模型服務與推論需求形成完整生態系，而不只是單純出售硬體。

從營收模式來看，若亞馬遜直接銷售Trainium系統，便有機會在AWS之外創造硬體收入，但必須先承擔庫存、製造與交付成本，並面臨類似Google TPU銷售模式的現金回收時間差。若採取授權或與其他雲端業者合作，則可能降低部分直接銷售與部署負擔，但收入分配、定價權及客戶關係也可能受到合作條件限制。若維持以雲端服務出租為主，則能延續AWS既有的服務模式，但外部客戶仍須透過合作平台或特定基礎設施使用Trainium。
因此，Trainium在2027年底走出AWS，真正值得觀察的並非單純多了多少潛在客戶，而是亞馬遜選擇哪一種商業模式，以及能否在擴大供應的同時維持投資報酬率。現階段可確認的是，客戶已主動要求Trainium開放至AWS以外，亞馬遜也已提出2027年底的規畫，現有部分產能需求強勁；但交易形式、定價、供應規模及合作對象都尚未公布。
在這些關鍵條件明朗前，將亞馬遜的計畫直接定義為「開始對外賣晶片」仍嫌過早。Google的經驗已顯示，自研AI晶片外部供應確實可能成為數十億美元甚至更大規模的收入來源，但背後也伴隨存貨、資本支出與現金回收壓力。對亞馬遜而言，Trainium能否從AWS內部的成本優勢，進一步轉變為AWS之外可獨立獲利的生意，將是2027年最值得追蹤的AI晶片布局之一。
paras_en: Amazon (AMZN-US) is preparing to take its in‑house AI chip Trainium beyond the AWS ecosystem. The next step isn’t just scaling chip usage but involves a new business model: will Amazon sell chips and servers directly, offer compute services through other cloud platforms, or pursue a different partnership arrangement? These choices will determine how much revenue Amazon can capture from strong chip demand and how much hardware investment and cash‑flow pressure it must shoulder.

CEO Andy Jassy told analysts on Thursday (the 29th) during the Q3 earnings call that, as Trainium demand stays robust, customers are repeatedly asking to make the chip available outside AWS. The company plans to have Trainium “available beyond AWS” by the end of 2027. Jassy did not specify the transaction structure, nor did he name partners, supply volumes or pricing. What is confirmed is that Trainium’s use cases will be broadened beyond AWS, but Amazon has not yet decided to sell the chips directly to customers.

Today Trainium is offered only as an AWS cloud instance; customers rent compute capacity rather than buying the silicon. If Amazon later shifts to hardware sales, it would have to bear chip fabrication, server assembly, inventory and delivery costs. Supplying the chip through other cloud providers could expand customer reach, but questions remain about who owns the hardware, who handles deployment, and how Amazon would be compensated. Different deal structures would affect revenue recognition, capex and profit margins in markedly different ways.

The move toward external markets comes as Amazon’s in‑house chip development and AI cloud services are heating up together. In July, Amazon disclosed that both its AI cloud and chip businesses each generate over $25 billion in annualized revenue, both growing at triple‑digit year‑over‑year rates. Jassy added that short‑term capacity for the previous‑generation Trainium instance is already outstripping supply and that pricing is higher than in the first half of the year, underscoring strong demand for existing compute resources.

AWS reported Q3 revenue of $45.98 billion, up 39.3% year‑over‑year, which translates to an annualized run‑rate of roughly $184 billion. The overall AWS backlog stands at $578 billion, also growing at triple‑digit rates. However, that backlog covers all of AWS’s cloud business; Amazon has not broken out Trainium‑specific orders, so the AWS backlog cannot be taken as a direct proxy for Trainium’s potential revenue.

Amazon continues to sharpen the cost advantage of its custom chips. Jassy said that customers using Amazon‑designed silicon in Q3 saved more than $2 billion in aggregate costs. After the launch of the Graviton 5 processor, backlog for the prior‑generation Graviton instances more than doubled versus the previous quarter; Graviton delivers 30‑40% better price‑performance versus x86 alternatives. Amazon also open‑sourced TorchNeuron, letting developers run PyTorch code on Trainium without major code rewrites.

In AI services, AWS inference revenue now accounts for over half of AWS AI revenue and is still growing. Jassy believes customers will not rely on a single model but will pick the best model for each workload. He expects that within two to three years the market could host six to eight competitive models that together satisfy more than 95% of workload needs. AWS Bedrock’s generative‑AI service could grow to a scale comparable with EC2, allowing Amazon to profit not only from the chip itself but also from cloud compute, model deployment and inference services.

If Trainium is to leave AWS, Google’s experience selling its Tensor Processing Units (TPU) externally offers a useful reference. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) has begun offering its custom TPUs to outside customers. Reuters reported that external TPU sales have generated billions of dollars in revenue, but the model also entails hardware investment and a lag between cash outlay and receipt. Unsold TPUs must be stocked, meaning Google incurs hardware costs before customers pay; CFO Anat Ashkenazi said most existing TPU contract revenue won’t be recognized until 2027.

TD Cowen estimates Google’s TPU sales operate at roughly a 20% operating margin, lower than Google Cloud’s overall ~35% margin. Alphabet has not disclosed TPU revenue or margins separately, so these figures are analyst estimates, not official guidance. The contrast highlights the difference between hardware sales and cloud services: even with strong external demand, suppliers must front hardware costs and manage the cash‑flow gap between inventory, delivery and payment.

Another approach is to place the custom chip on other cloud platforms. On Tuesday (the 27th), Alphabet announced that Oracle (ORCL-US) will allow Oracle Cloud customers to use Google TPUs starting in 2027. This marks the first time a Google TPU appears on a hyperscale cloud outside Google’s own infrastructure. Google also opened TPU access to external data centers beginning in Q2, expanding usage scenarios.

The specific supply terms between Google and Oracle were not disclosed, including whether TPUs will be sold, leased or provided under another arrangement, leaving the market unable to gauge each party’s capital‑expenditure commitment or how Google will recoup its hardware investment. Google Cloud CEO Thomas Kurian has said Google’s AI servers can pay for themselves in under two years, and servers using Google’s own chips could halve that payback period. This shows that custom chips can cut compute costs and potentially improve data‑center investment returns, though actual benefits depend on utilization, customer contracts and supply terms.

Anthropic’s procurement plan reflects large AI players’ desire for a multi‑chip strategy. Its IPO filing shows the company uses chips from Google, Amazon, NVIDIA (NVDA-US) and AMD (AMD-US), selecting the most cost‑effective and performant option for each workload. The filing also reveals Anthropic has pledged $114.5 billion in Google compute purchases from April 2026 through July 2033. This long‑term commitment does not mean Google will recognize the full amount as revenue during that period, nor can the entire sum be treated as TPU revenue.

Earlier reports indicated Anthropic is expanding its use of Google TPUs and is in talks with Google and other suppliers for large compute allocations. Such demand shows AI model developers are actively seeking alternatives to NVIDIA GPUs, using a multi‑chip supplier strategy to lower cost and mitigate supply risk. For Amazon, if Trainium can capture more customers outside AWS, it could turn a chip that is currently locked to its own cloud into a broader external revenue stream.

Wall Street is watching Google’s TPU revenue potential closely. Mizuho projects TPU revenue could rise from $28 billion in 2026 to $67 billion in 2027 and reach $100 billion in 2028. TD Cowen’s more optimistic outlook sees 2028 TPU revenue at $138 billion (≈ 184 trillion won), about 34% of Google Cloud’s revenue. These numbers are analyst forecasts, not Alphabet‑issued targets, and do not imply Google has secured all external supply contracts yet.

For Amazon, the commercial model for external Trainium supply is especially critical as the company is in a rapid capex expansion phase. Over the past 12 months Amazon’s free cash flow was a $42.36 billion outflow, contrasting with a $14.79 billion inflow a year earlier; this year’s capex is expected to be about $220 billion, and Jassy said 2027 spending will be “significantly higher” than this year. Ongoing investment in data centers, chips and AI infrastructure helps secure long‑term demand but also puts cash‑flow and investment‑return timing under market scrutiny.

Jassy emphasized during the earnings call that AWS follows a long‑term platform strategy, distinct from the model of merely hosting third‑party GPUs or renting short‑term data‑center capacity, and noted that the company’s capex recovery rate is accelerating. This signals Amazon’s intent to build a full ecosystem of chips, cloud platform, AI models and inference services rather than simply selling hardware.

From a revenue‑model perspective, if Amazon sells Trainium systems directly, it could generate hardware revenue outside AWS but would have to assume inventory, manufacturing and delivery costs and face a cash‑flow lag similar to Google’s TPU sales. Licensing or partnering with other cloud providers could reduce direct‑sale and deployment burdens, but revenue sharing, pricing power and customer relationships would be subject to partnership terms. Maintaining a cloud‑service‑rental focus would preserve AWS’s existing model, though external customers would still need to access Trainium via partner platforms or specific infrastructure.

Thus, the key question when Trainium leaves AWS by the end of 2027 is not merely how many additional potential customers there are, but which business model Amazon selects and whether it can sustain investment returns while scaling supply. What is certain now is that customers have asked for Trainium to be available beyond AWS, Amazon has set a 2027 timeline, and current capacity demand is strong; however, the transaction structure, pricing, supply scale and partner choices remain undisclosed.

Until those critical terms are clarified, labeling Amazon’s plan as “selling chips externally” is premature. Google’s experience shows that external sales of custom AI chips can become a multi‑billion‑dollar revenue stream, but they also bring inventory, capex and cash‑recovery pressures. For Amazon, the ability of Trainium to translate its internal cost advantage into a profitable, stand‑alone business outside AWS will be one of the most closely watched AI‑chip developments in 2027.

items.title: Alphabet財報引爆AI支出疑慮！美股收黑、小型股逆勢走強，資金轉向非科技族群
items.title_en: Alphabet Earnings Spark AI Spending Concerns; US Stocks Close Lower, Small‑Cap Stocks Rise, Funds Shift to Non‑Tech Sectors
paras: 2026年10月30日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股周四(29日)收低，Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)營收不如預期，加上AI投資加速消耗現金，再度引發市場對大型科技公司資本支出的疑慮，那斯達克指數跌逾1%，費城半導體指數也中止連四日漲勢。不過，小型股羅素2000指數逆勢走高，顯示賣壓主要集中在科技與AI相關類股，尚未全面擴散。
Alphabet前一日盤後公布財報，營收未達市場預期，AI相關支出帶來的現金消耗也加快，拖累股價與通訊服務類股。投資人開始更仔細區分，哪些公司有能力以自身現金流支應AI投資，哪些公司則需要消耗現金、增加借款才能維持擴張。
Baird投資策略分析師Ross Mayfield表示，科技股承壓時，小型股仍能走強，反映市場認為AI投資題材出現疑慮，並不代表整體市場前景同步惡化，資金仍可轉往其他展望較佳的領域。
總體經濟方面，美國第三季國內生產毛額(GDP)初值成長3.4%，優於分析師預期，但戰爭引發的石油供應緊縮，也讓通膨壓力持續升溫。聯準會前一日決議維持利率不變，並表示將等待更多資訊，再決定下一步政策。
個股表現分化。禮來Eli Lilly(LLY-US)受惠減重藥銷售強勁，上調營收展望，帶動股價走高；福特Ford(F-US)營收優於預期，默克Merck(MRK-US)獲利也受癌症藥物Keytruda與HPV疫苗Gardasil支撐，兩家公司股價均上漲。卡特彼勒Caterpillar(CAT-US)雖然獲利優於預期，但未上調成長目標，股價重挫。
軟體股則面臨明顯賣壓，Fortinet(FTNT-US)與ServiceNow(NOW-US)公布財報後，股價均下跌逾20%。邁威爾Marvell(MRVL-US)因傳出深入洽談收購魯門特姆Lumentum(LITE-US)而大跌，Lumentum則上漲。
整體企業獲利仍具支撐。標普500已有253家公司公布財報，其中81%獲利優於預期，分析師預估第三季整體獲利年增31%。市場接下來將關注亞馬遜Amazon(AMZN-US)盤後公布的財報，觀察雲端需求與AI投資能否提供更多營運回報的證據。

paras_en: On Thursday, October 29, US equities closed lower as Alphabet (GOOGL-US), Google’s parent, reported revenue that missed expectations and accelerated cash burn from AI investments, reviving worries about capital spending at large tech firms. The Nasdaq fell more than 1% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index ended its four‑day rally, while the small‑cap Russell 2000 rose, indicating that selling pressure was concentrated in tech and AI‑related stocks and had not yet spread broadly.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 132.54 points, down 0.25% to 52,342; the S&P 500 fell 23.59 points, down 0.30% to 7,720.39; and the Nasdaq dropped 366.13 points, down 1.38% to 26,184.

Alphabet released its earnings after the market close the previous day, showing revenue below analysts’ forecasts and faster cash consumption from AI‑related spending, which weighed on its stock and the communications‑services sector. Investors are now scrutinizing which companies can fund AI projects with internal cash flow and which will need to burn cash or raise debt to sustain expansion.

Baird investment strategist Ross Mayfield said that while tech stocks are under pressure, small‑cap stocks can still advance, reflecting the market’s view that concerns about AI spending do not imply a broader deterioration in outlook and that capital can rotate into other sectors with better prospects.

On the macro side, U.S. third‑quarter GDP came in at a 3.4% annualized pace, beating forecasts, but war‑driven oil supply constraints keep inflation pressures elevated. The Fed left rates unchanged the day before and said it will wait for more data before deciding on the next policy step.

Individual stocks showed mixed performance. Eli Lilly (LLY‑US) rose on strong weight‑loss drug sales and an upgraded revenue outlook; Ford (F‑US) beat revenue estimates; and Merck (MRK‑US) saw profit supported by its cancer drug Keytruda and HPV vaccine Gardasil, lifting both stocks. Caterpillar (CAT‑US) posted earnings above expectations but did not raise its growth target, causing its shares to plunge.

Software stocks faced clear selling pressure: Fortinet (FTNT‑US) and ServiceNow (NOW‑US) each fell more than 20% after reporting results, and Marvell (MRVL‑US) tumbled on rumors of deep talks to acquire Lumentum (LITE‑US), which itself rose.

Overall corporate earnings remain supportive. Of the 253 S&P 500 companies that have reported, 81% beat profit expectations, and analysts project third‑quarter earnings to be up 31% year‑over‑year. The market will now focus on Amazon’s (AMZN‑US) after‑hours earnings to gauge whether cloud demand and AI investment can deliver additional operating returns.

items.title: Google搜尋業務失速後換亞馬遜零售業！科技巨頭搖錢樹接連踢鐵板 現金流惡化引發拋售潮
paras: 正當投資市場圍繞人工智慧(AI)打轉時，拼命砸錢擴張的科技巨頭卻接連在核心業務上踢到鐵板：亞馬遜(AMZN-US)賴以成名的零售業務表現不如預期，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)問題則是出在搜尋業務成長放緩，兩者股價都因此暴跌。

Alphabet搜尋和廣告業務疲弱、現金缺口擴大

Alphabet周四終場狂瀉12.3%至每股282.32美元，創下上市以來最慘財報後表現。該公司第3季自由現金流為負90.7億美元，顯示現金缺口在第2季首度出現之後進一步擴大，而且遠低於分析師預估的負27億美元。
Alphabet周三公布的財報顯示，攸關AI發展的Google Cloud表現亮眼，營收較去年同期倍增，遠優於市場預期，營業利益率達38%，比華爾街共識預估高出2.3個百分點。
但核心的Google搜尋與YouTube廣告業務卻表現疲弱，
而且自由現金流連兩季為負，缺口從第2季的59億美元擴大至91億美元，遠遜於分析師預估的27億美元。

亞馬遜零售與廣告業務遜色、現金流連三季為負

亞馬遜公布財報後，周四(29日)盤後一度下挫逾7%，在公布財報前，亞馬遜股價今年來累計上漲5.6%。
財報顯示，亞馬遜第3季每股獲利1.89美元，低於去年同期的1.95美元和分析師預估的1.97美元。淨銷售額年增12%至2,019億美元，略低於華爾街預估的2,022億美元。
主力的零售業務成長正在放緩：北美部門第3季銷售額年增6%至1,129億美元，低於市場所估的1,132億美元，國際部門銷售額年增5%至431億美元，也比市場預期少約5億美元。
在廣告業務方面，與Google類似，亞馬遜也顯露疲態，年增率從前一季的26%放緩至12%。
目前還無法期待亞馬遜的業績能立即回溫，因為該公司對第4季的財測同樣令人失望：亞馬遜預估本季營業利益中值為310億美元，遠低於分析師預期的332億美元。

AWS成長強勁 雲端業務仍是亮點

攸關AI隸屬的雲端業務仍是亮點，亞馬遜網路服務(AWS)第3季營收年增39%至460億美元，優於分析師預期。
但AWS也並非毫無問題。AI資料中心興建成本使亞馬遜連續三季的自由現金流為負。此外，亞馬遜維持2026年資本支出預估在2,200億美元不變，這是投資人現階段最關注的財務指標之一。
Direxion資本市場主管Jake Behan表示：「AWS成長加速，讓AI投資更容易獲得合理解釋，但不代表成本就此消失。資料中心建置仍使自由現金流承受重大壓力。」

Anthropic為AWS帶來風險

市場也正高度關注AWS因Anthropic面臨的風險。Anthropic本周一公布首次公開發行(IPO)公開說明書，提及亞馬遜及AWS共166次，而且Anthropic也是AWS近期業績表現的重要推動力，AWS成長率開始加速的時間點，恰好與Anthropic銷售額激增相吻合。
亞馬遜與Anthropic的關係相當複雜：亞馬遜既是競爭對手，也是經銷商、客戶及供應商。Anthropic上市後，亞馬遜還將成為持股逾5%的股東。
其中最大的風險，在於Anthropic與AWS簽訂的10年期、總額1,100億美元合約，然而這還只是Anthropic與多家雲端服務商簽訂的眾多合約之一。
當亞馬遜、Alphabet、微軟(MSFT-US)、SpaceX(SPCX-US)、超微(AMD-US)、博通(AVGO-US)、Nscale及Lambda都寄望Anthropic未來有能力支付龐大帳單，一旦Anthropic陷入困境，連鎖效應便可能接連發生。

items.title: 以大選投票率創27年新高卻「沒贏家」！尼坦雅胡喊「選舉被竊」 反對派警告他可能干擾組閣
items.title_en: Record 27-Year High Voter Turnout Yet No Clear Winner; Netanyahu Claims “Election Stolen,” Opposition Warns He May Interfere with Government Formation
paras: 以色列中央選舉委員會周四(29日)晚間完成本屆國會大選初步計票，結果顯示總理尼坦雅胡領軍的右翼執政聯盟獲53席，反對派領袖、前參謀總長埃森科特陣營取得48席，阿拉伯裔政黨合計拿下19席。在120席議會中，無任一陣營跨越組閣門檻61席。
依選舉程序，選委會完成法定核驗與申訴處理後，將於11月4日公告正式結果，隨後由總統赫爾佐格諮商各黨、授權組閣，候選人原則上有28天期程，可延長14天；若兩輪失利，則可能走向第三輪授權或重新大選。
本屆投票率衝上77.7%，創1999年以來新高，阿拉伯社群動員尤為關鍵，兩大阿拉伯政黨合計席次較選前近乎翻倍，成為決定政局的「關鍵少數」。也正是這股票源，觸發敗選方對合法性的連番攻擊。
計票尚未塵埃落定，利庫德集團已率先發難。尼坦雅胡選前即質疑阿拉伯選區高投票率，投票日後更指稱選舉遭「竊取」。
利庫德集團表示，阿拉伯政黨透過賄賂與外國資金動員選民，其援引個案為拉阿姆黨三名活動人士涉嫌付費買票被捕。但以色列警方明確表態，目前無證據支持「大規模舞弊」指控，選委會亦定性該案為地方性孤立事件。
爭議隨後升級至「外國干預」層級。以國選委會主席、最高法院法官索爾貝格致函國安局(Shin Bet)局長，要求一週內查明是否有外國實體資助阿拉伯社群投票動員。以國媒體點名卡達，懷疑資金用以拉抬投票率，卡達外交部已否認介入。
更受矚目的是情報通報時程。以國國安局選前數週即掌握相關線索，卻未在投票日公開示警，選後才先向選委會、再向內塔尼亞胡簡報，遲未通知主要對手埃森科特，直至信件外洩才補通報。反對派痛批此舉形同讓執政方壟斷資訊、稀釋選舉正當性。以國國安局則強調調查範圍嚴格受限，「不應以此污名化整個阿拉伯族群行使投票權」。
反對派目前帳面席次達67席，理論上超越多數門檻，但執政權並非數字遊戲。埃森科特直言，尼坦雅胡正發動「輿論戰」，試圖拖延新國會宣誓、阻擋反對派與阿拉伯政黨合作，並癱瘓議長更替與「10月7日事件」國家調查委員會的成立——後者正是尼坦雅胡三年來極力迴避的政治地雷。
利庫德則揚言，任何猶太復國主義政黨都不應與阿拉伯政黨結盟。反對派內部同樣分歧：部分右翼成員拒絕倚賴阿拉伯票源執政，使67席優勢難以直接轉化為政府。
接下來三週，市場與外交觀察者將緊盯三條變數：11月4日結果能否如期認證、新國會是否順利就職、國安局調查會否拋出足以翻盤的證據。在組閣算術與族群敘事交錯下，以色列政局的下一步，仍繫於一場尚未寫完的信任投票。
paras_en: Israel's Central Election Committee completed a preliminary count of this parliamentary election on Thursday night (the 29th), showing that Prime Minister Netanyahu's right‑wing governing alliance won 53 seats, opposition leader and former chief of staff Eskenazi's camp secured 48 seats, and Arab parties together took 19 seats. In the 120‑seat Knesset, no bloc reached the 61‑seat threshold needed to form a government.

According to electoral procedure, after the committee finishes legal verification and handles appeals, it will announce the official results on November 4, after which President Herzog will consult the parties and authorize coalition talks. Candidates normally have a 28‑day window, which can be extended by 14 days; if two attempts fail, a third round of authorization or a new election may follow.

Turnout this cycle surged to 77.7%, the highest since 1999, with the Arab community’s mobilization proving decisive; the two major Arab parties roughly doubled their seats compared with pre‑election forecasts, becoming the “critical minority” that could tip the balance. This very factor sparked a series of legitimacy attacks from the losing side.

While the count was still unsettled, the Likud bloc moved first. Netanyahu had already questioned the high turnout in Arab districts before the vote and, after voting day, claimed the election had been “stolen.”

Likud alleges Arab parties used bribery and foreign money to mobilize voters, citing a case where three activists from the Ra'am party were arrested for allegedly buying votes. Israeli police, however, have stated there is no evidence of “large‑scale fraud,” and the election committee classified the incident as an isolated local matter.

The controversy then escalated to accusations of “foreign interference.” Election Committee chair and Supreme Court judge Solberg wrote to Shin Bet chief demanding a one‑week investigation into whether any foreign entity funded Arab community mobilization. Israeli media singled out Qatar, suspecting its funds boosted turnout, which Qatar’s foreign ministry has denied.

The timing of intelligence reporting drew further criticism. Shin Bet had obtained relevant leads weeks before the election but did not issue a public warning on voting day; it only briefed the election committee after the vote and later informed Netanyahu, failing to notify main opponent Eskenazi until a leak forced a belated notice. The opposition blasted the move as allowing the ruling side to monopolize information and undermine electoral legitimacy, while Shin Bet stressed its probe was narrowly scoped and should not stigmatize the entire Arab electorate.

The opposition currently holds 67 seats on paper, theoretically surpassing the majority threshold, but governing power is not just a numbers game. Eskenazi said Netanyahu is waging an “opinion war,” trying to delay the new Knesset’s oath, block cooperation between the opposition and Arab parties, and paralyze the election of a speaker and the formation of the inquiry committee into the October 7 events—a political landmine Netanyahu has long avoided.

Likud warned that no Zionist party should ally with Arab parties. The opposition itself is divided: some right‑wing members refuse to rely on Arab votes to govern, making it hard to translate the 67‑seat advantage into a governing coalition.

In the coming three weeks, markets and diplomatic observers will watch three variables closely: whether the November 4 result is certified on schedule, whether the new Knesset is sworn in smoothly, and whether Shin Bet’s investigation produces evidence that could overturn the outcome. Amid the arithmetic of coalition building and competing ethnic narratives, Israel’s next political step hinges on a trust vote that is still being written.

items.title: 華爾街日報：美國施壓 烏克蘭已暫停攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠
paras: 知情人士透露，烏克蘭軍方已暫停攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠，此前美國總統川普連續數周施壓，動搖了基輔對美國支持的信心。
據《華爾街日報》29日（周四）報導，消息人士說，這次非正式暫停預計將持續到美國國會期中選舉之後，也可能延續至11月更晚。
烏克蘭政府尚未宣布暫停襲擊俄羅斯煉油廠。烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基曾表示，希望本國能源基礎設施得到更多保護，以此作為暫緩打擊的交換條件。在冬季來臨前，俄羅斯一直在通過飛彈和無人機攻擊，系統性摧毀這些設施。
兩名知情軍方官員說，參與遠程打擊的烏克蘭部隊在10月中旬接到通知，在完成已經啟動的任務後，對煉油廠的打擊行動實際上就暫停了。
一名消息人士說，烏克蘭國防部長Evgeniy Khmara告訴澤倫斯基，鑒於外交局勢波譎雲詭，軍方認為最好暫緩攻擊煉油廠。該人士說，澤倫斯基表示可以，但他強調軍方仍可自行決定再次襲擊煉油廠。
談及暫緩打擊煉油廠，澤倫斯基27日在基輔對記者說：「官兵這幾天儘量更謹慎一些，但軍隊並沒有接到『禁打煉油廠』的命令。」 澤倫斯基說，無人機部隊正在攻擊俄羅斯境內不同類型的目標。
儘管川普去年重返白宮時終止了美國對基輔的大部分軍事和財政援助，但烏克蘭對「星鏈」（Starlink）、美國情報共享和「愛國者」飛彈的依賴，仍使其易受美國施壓。
近幾周川普不斷向澤倫斯基施壓，要求停止打擊俄羅斯煉油廠，並將全球燃料價格高漲歸咎於烏克蘭。但能源專家表示，燃料價格走高主要是伊朗戰爭引發。
共和黨候選人擔心，燃料價格可能影響期中選舉選情。川普已放寬對俄羅斯柴油的制裁，以期緩解美國農民等消費者的壓力。

items.title: 揖斐電IBIDEN三個月內兩度上修財測：AI晶片尺寸放大，ABF載板為何擴產仍吃緊？
items.title_en: IBIDEN Raises Full-Year Forecast Twice in Three Months: AI Chip Size Increases, Why Is ABF Substrate Expansion Still Tight?
paras: 2026年10月30日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 日本ABF載板大廠揖斐電IBIDEN(4062-JP)上修全年財測，反映AI需求已帶動獲利成長。不過，載板供給吃緊不只是晶片出貨增加，隨產品面積放大、層數提高，每顆晶片消耗的製程產能也跟著增加，使擴產速度未必能跟上需求。
揖斐電10月29日將2026會計年度(2026年4月至2027年3月)營收預估由5,500億上修至5,650億日圓，營業利益由1,270億提高至1,330億日圓，分別年增約36%及1.1倍。依財測推算，全年營業利益率將由14.9%升至約23.5%，主要受惠於AI伺服器等高附加價值產品訂單優於預期、產品組合改善及日圓走弱。
這已是揖斐電不到三個月內第二度上修財測。公司8月4日先將全年營收預估由5,000億提高至5,500億日圓，營業利益由900億調升至1,270億日圓，昨日再度上調。相較5月公布的原始財測，全年營收與營業利益預估已累計上修13%及約48%，反映公司將更多下半年的產能分配到AI與伺服器載板，需求強度也持續優於原先預期。
載板規格持續升級，成為這一波產業週期中影響供需的最重要因素。輝達Hopper載板面積約3,300平方毫米、12層，對Rubin的估計則達8,000平方毫米、18層，面積約增至2.4倍、層數增加五成。由於同一片生產面板能容納的載板數量減少，加工與良率管理也更複雜，因此，這一波週期不能直接把設備增加幅度當成供應端的出貨成長幅度。
需求也正從GPU延伸至CPU、ASIC與交換器晶片。英特爾Intel(INTC-US)同日法說會指出，EMIB先進封裝所需的有機載板短缺，已限制伺服器CPU出貨，執行長陳立武更親赴日本拜訪供應商、爭取產能。公司雖已談妥增加40%載板產能，但大部分要到2027年下半年才開出，短期供給仍難以跟上需求。
揖斐電同步核准約1,510億日圓新增投資，主要用於Gama廠Cell 6及海外產能，其中Cell 6以AI ASIC載板為主，預計2029會計年度(即日曆年2029年4月至2030年3月)陸續投產。輝達也透過產能預付款支持揖斐電Ono廠擴建，並以產能預約協議支持欣興(3037-TW)光復廠擴產。

paras_en: October 30, 2026 (Youshi Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Japanese ABF substrate giant IBIDEN (4062-JP) raised its full‑year financial outlook, reflecting profit growth driven by AI demand. However, substrate supply constraints are not only due to higher chip shipments; as product area expands and layer counts rise, each chip consumes more process capacity, so expansion may not keep pace with demand.

On October 29, IBIDEN lifted its FY2026 (April 2026‑March 2027) revenue estimate from ¥550 billion to ¥565 billion and operating profit from ¥127 billion to ¥133 billion, roughly a 36% and 1.1‑times year‑over‑year increase respectively. The revised outlook implies an operating margin rising from 14.9% to about 23.5%, mainly thanks to stronger‑than‑expected orders for high‑value AI servers, an improved product mix and a weaker yen.

This is the second forecast revision within less than three months. On August 4 the company had already raised its full‑year revenue estimate from ¥500 billion to ¥550 billion and operating profit from ¥90 billion to ¥127 billion, and it upgraded again yesterday. Compared with the original May guidance, the cumulative upgrades amount to +13% in revenue and about +48% in operating profit, reflecting a larger share of second‑half capacity being allocated to AI and server substrates and demand staying stronger than initially expected.

Substrate specifications continue to advance, becoming the most critical supply‑demand factor in this cycle. Nvidia’s Hopper substrate measures about 3,300 mm² with 12 layers, while the Rubin estimate reaches 8,000 mm² and 18 layers – a 2.4‑fold area increase and a 50% rise in layer count. Because fewer substrates fit on a single wafer and processing and yield management become more complex, equipment expansion cannot be directly equated with supply‑side shipment growth in this cycle.

Demand is also spreading from GPUs to CPUs, ASICs and switch chips. Intel (INTC‑US) said in its same‑day earnings call that a shortage of organic substrates needed for EMIB advanced packaging has limited server‑CPU shipments; CEO Pat Gelsinger even visited suppliers in Japan to secure capacity. Although the company has secured a 40% increase in substrate capacity, most of it won’t be available until the second half of 2027, leaving short‑term supply unable to meet demand.

IBIDEN simultaneously approved about ¥151 billion of new investment, mainly for its Gama plant Cell 6 and overseas capacity. Cell 6 will focus on AI ASIC substrates and is slated for phased start‑up in FY2029 (April 2029‑March 2030). Nvidia is also supporting IBIDEN’s Ono plant expansion through capacity pre‑payments and has backed Xinxing (3037‑TW) Guangfu plant expansion via capacity reservation agreements.
