items.title: 比特幣跌破7.8萬美元！幣安疑遭駭客攻擊 Circle、Tether凍結25.4億美元資金
items.title_en: Bitcoin Falls Below $78,000! Binance Suspected Hack Prompts Circle and Tether to Freeze $2.54 Billion
paras: 比特幣(BTC)周五(30日)跌破7.8萬美元，市場擔憂加密貨幣交易所幣安(Binance)疑似發現資安漏洞，整體事件撼動數位資產市場，並促使包括穩定幣發行商Circle(CRCL-US)與Tether(USDT)在內的多家加密貨幣業者凍結與疑似事件相關的資金，合計達25.4億美元。
比特幣下跌逾4%，報77,994.96美元。這個市值最大加密貨幣周二跌破重要心理關卡8萬美元之後，跌勢進一步擴大。
市值第二大的加密貨幣以太幣(ETH)下跌4.84%，報2,247.45美元。幣安原生代幣BNB重挫7.68%，報694.45美元。
不過Hyperliquid的HYPE代幣逆勢上漲9.7%，報89.08美元，與整體市場跌勢背道而馳。

Circle、Tether聯手凍結25.4億美元資金

多家加密貨幣業者周四凍結與這起疑似事件有關的資金，合計達25.4億美元。
Circle執行長Jeremy Allaire表示，已凍結超過8億美元的美元穩定幣USDC。Tether執行長Paolo Ardoino則表示，已停止涉及超過15億美元USDT的交易，這些資金可能與幣安的資安漏洞有關。
幣安共同創辦人何一表示，Ripple(XRP)也協助阻止2億美元、與這起疑似攻擊事件有關的資金轉移。
區塊鏈分析公司Arkham Intelligence辨識出55個錢包地址，其中持有的數位資產總額近60億美元，可能與這起事件有關。這顯示，疑似資安事件的規模可能遠大於目前遭凍結的資金。

幣安尚未證實遭駭客攻擊

幣安尚未明確證實發生駭客攻擊，僅表示正在調查有關潛在資安問題的通報。該公司發言人表示，「我們的團隊已注意到有關潛在資安問題的通報，目前正積極調查」，並補充，使用者資金仍然安全。
幣安創辦人兼前執行長趙長鵬也試圖安撫投資人，強調客戶資金安全，但他表示，這起事件看起來像是駭客攻擊。
然而，這起事件再度喚起市場對加密貨幣產業資安漏洞的疑慮：2025年，加密貨幣交易所Bybit遭駭客攻擊，損失約15億美元。而不久前，另一家交易所Bitget也因網路竊盜損失超過3.5億美元的數位資產。
paras_en: Bitcoin (BTC) fell below $78,000 on Friday (the 30th) as market worries grew over a possible security breach at crypto exchange Binance, shaking the digital‑asset market and prompting several crypto firms, including stable‑coin issuers Circle (CRCL‑US) and Tether (USDT), to freeze funds linked to the incident, totalling $2.54 billion.
Bitcoin dropped more than 4% to $77,994.96. The market‑cap‑largest cryptocurrency, after breaking the key psychological barrier of $80,000 on Tuesday, saw its decline accelerate further.
The second‑largest cryptocurrency, Ether (ETH), fell 4.84% to $2,247.45, while Binance’s native token BNB plunged 7.68% to $694.45.
However, Hyperliquid’s HYPE token rose 9.7% to $89.08, moving opposite to the broader market trend.
Circle and Tether jointly froze $2.54 billion in funds. Several crypto firms on Thursday froze money they said was related to the suspected incident, amounting to a total of $2.54 billion.

Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire said the firm has frozen more than $800 million worth of USDC stablecoins. Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said it has halted transactions involving over $1.5 billion of USDT, which may be tied to Binance’s security breach.
Binance co‑founder He Yi said Ripple (XRP) also helped block $200 million of fund transfers linked to the suspected attack.

Blockchain analytics firm Arkham Intelligence identified 55 wallet addresses holding nearly $6 billion in digital assets that may be connected to the event, suggesting the breach’s scale could be far larger than the frozen amount.

Binance has not confirmed a hack. The exchange said it is investigating reports of a potential security issue, with a spokesperson noting, “Our team is aware of the reports and is actively investigating,” and adding that user funds remain safe.
Binance founder and former CEO Zhao Changpeng also tried to reassure investors, emphasizing the safety of client funds, but he said the incident appears to be a hacking attempt.

The episode revives market concerns over security flaws in the crypto industry: in 2025, exchange Bybit was hacked, losing about $1.5 billion, and not long ago, another exchange, Bitget, suffered a cyber‑theft of over $350 million in digital assets.

items.title: 疑似遭駭客攻擊！全球最大加密貨幣交易所幣安凍資約30億美元 比特幣跌破7.9萬美元
items.title_en: Possible Hack! Binance, the World’s Largest Crypto Exchange, Freezes About $3 Billion; Bitcoin Falls Below $79,000
paras: 全球最大加密貨幣交易所幣安(Binance)疑遭史上最大規模駭客攻擊，正緊急調查並凍結相關資產，並證實目前已凍結約30億美元資產，且數字可能隨追蹤進度繼續攀升。該交易所還強調，尚無法確認用戶資金受影響，用戶資產安全為當前優先處理事項。
事件引爆市場恐慌。周四下午，幣安用戶錢包一度流出逾57億美元資產，比特幣價格應聲重挫3.7%，跌破7.9萬美元，創9月來新低，其他加密貨幣同步遭到拋售。
目前，幣安已暫停提幣及幣安Alpha交易，並會同執法部門、代幣發行方、區塊鏈情報公司與業界夥伴追查資金流向。
幣安發言人表示，安全團隊正緊急審查所有相關資訊，僅會在官方渠道公布經核實據，外界流傳的18億美元等不同版本，均非最終確認口徑。
幣安共同創辦人趙長鵬(CZ)在X平台上指出，交易所「似乎遭到駭客攻擊」，並預期若確認損失，所有用戶資金將獲全額賠付；他雖已退出日常營運，仍是幣安最大股東。
區塊鏈追蹤平台Arkham已識別出與疑似駭客相關錢包，持倉約59億美元，但該數字不等同於實際盜走金額。分析師與交易員推估，本次潛在被盜規模介於17億至57億美元之間。
這起事件發生於所謂的「黑色十月」期間，近期一連串高調網攻與AI發現的漏洞，令市場憂心全球性加密危機。加密交易公司JPEG Trading聯合創始人Kevin March直言：「這是前所未見的。」
paras_en: The world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange Binance is suspected of suffering the biggest hack in history and is urgently investigating while freezing related assets. It has confirmed that roughly $3 billion worth of assets have been frozen so far, and the figure may rise as the investigation proceeds. The exchange emphasized that it cannot yet confirm any impact on user funds, and safeguarding user assets is the top priority.

The incident sparked market panic. On Thursday afternoon, more than $5.7 billion flowed out of Binance users’ wallets, prompting Bitcoin to plunge 3.7% and slip below $79,000, a September low, while other cryptocurrencies were sold off in tandem.

Binance has temporarily halted withdrawals and Binance Alpha trading, and is working with law‑enforcement agencies, token issuers, blockchain intelligence firms and industry partners to trace the flow of funds.

A Binance spokesperson said the security team is urgently reviewing all related information and will only publish verified data through official channels. Various unverified figures circulating in the media, such as $1.8 billion, are not the final confirmed amount.

Binance co‑founder Changpeng Zhao (CZ) posted on X that the exchange “appears to have been hacked” and said that if losses are confirmed, all user funds will be fully compensated; although he has stepped back from day‑to‑day operations, he remains the largest shareholder.

Blockchain tracking platform Arkham has identified wallets linked to the suspected hackers holding about $5.9 billion, but this does not equal the amount actually stolen. Analysts and traders estimate the potential theft to be between $1.7 billion and $5.7 billion.

The incident occurred during the so‑called “Black October” period, a string of high‑profile cyber‑attacks and AI‑discovered vulnerabilities that have raised concerns of a global crypto crisis. Kevin March, co‑founder of crypto trading firm JPEG Trading, bluntly said: “This is unprecedented.”

items.title: 星巴克在中國推「消費入座」後 宜家、霸王茶姬等品牌有門市試點
items.title_en: Starbucks Launches “Consume to Sit” in China; IKEA, BaWang Tea House and Others Pilot the Policy
paras: 近日星巴克(SBUX-US) 在全中國門市啟動「消費入座」倡議，商家消費空間與座位資源該如何管理引發關注，目前多個品牌門市出現類似「消費入座」提示。
近日有中國網友反映，上海徐匯宜家餐廳開始實行「消費入座」，周二、周四還有保安勸離佔座的消費者。
宜家上海徐匯商場對此表示，餐廳內出現了長時間佔座、喧譁、食用自帶食物等非用餐行為，一定程度上影響了部分顧客正常就餐，採取每周二和周四「用餐就座」引導，是希望確保座位資源能更好地服務於有實際用餐需求的顧客。
中國其餘宜家商場餐廳還沒有同步出現同類措施。
據《界面新聞》29日（周四）報導，一些茶飲品牌的門市也採取了類似提示。有網友發帖，稱在霸王茶姬山東臨沂某個門市看到桌上擺放了「消費入座」的標識。
霸王茶姬青島萬象城店工作人員29日表示，該門市執行「消費入座」的規則，此前提示牌被顧客弄掉了，正在重新製作。門市工作人員稱，提示主要針對長期佔位、自帶外賣佔座的情況，彈性執行，短暫進店歇腳的消費者不會被勸離。
另外，還有成都消費者在網上曬出24日拍到一家奈雪的茶(02150-HK) 門市「消費入座」提示牌，不過她說自己在店內停留約30分鐘，有未消費顧客就座，店員並未提醒或勸離。
奈雪的茶客服熱線人員對此回應：總部沒「消費入座」相關規定，門市可根據經營需要自行決定。
瑞幸、庫迪、喜茶、Manner、Tims、麥當勞(MCD-US) 、肯德基等品牌，總部均未有明確消費入座統一政策。
對於商家推行「消費入座」，不少消費者表示支持，門市有控制營運成本、保障付費顧客權益的合理訴求，如果過多未消費顧客佔用消費顧客空間，對門市消費者來講也不公平。
paras_en: Starbucks (SBUX-US) has recently rolled out a “consume to sit” initiative across all its stores in China, sparking discussion about how merchants should manage dining space and seating resources, and prompting similar signage at several other brand locations.

A Chinese netizen reported that IKEA’s restaurant in Shanghai’s Xuhui store has begun enforcing “consume to sit,” with security staff on Tuesdays and Thursdays asking customers who are occupying seats without ordering to leave.

IKEA’s Xuhui Shanghai mall explained that the restaurant has seen prolonged seat‑holding, noise, and customers eating food they brought in, which to some extent disrupts other diners; the Tuesday and Thursday “dine‑and‑sit” guidance aims to ensure seats are better used by those with genuine dining needs.
Other IKEA restaurant locations in China have not yet adopted the same measures.

According to a report by Jiemian News on Thursday the 29th, some tea‑drink brands have also posted similar notices; a netizen said they saw a “consume to sit” sign on a table at a BaWang Tea House outlet in Linyi, Shandong.

Staff at BaWang Tea House’s Qingdao Wanxiang City store said on the 29th that the outlet is enforcing the “consume to sit” rule, that a previous sign had been knocked down by a customer and is being remade, and that the notice mainly targets long‑term seat‑holding and customers bringing in take‑away food, while casual short‑term visitors will not be asked to leave.

In addition, a consumer in Chengdu posted a photo taken on the 24th of a “consume to sit” sign at a Naixue’s Tea (02150-HK) store, but said she stayed about 30 minutes, saw non‑paying customers seated, and was not reminded or asked to leave by staff.
A Naixue’s Tea customer‑service representative replied that the headquarters has no “consume to sit” policy, leaving each store free to decide based on its operational needs.
Brands such as Luckin Coffee, Kudi, Heytea, Manner, Tim Hortons, McDonald’s (MCD-US) and KFC have no unified “consume to sit” policy from their headquarters.

Many consumers support the “consume to sit” practice, noting that it helps stores control operating costs and protect the rights of paying customers; excessive occupation of seating by non‑paying patrons is seen as unfair to those who are actually buying.

items.title: 星巴克Q4營收、國際銷售不如預期 盤後股價轉跌
items.title_en: Starbucks Q4 Revenue and International Sales Miss Expectations; After-Hours Stock Falls
paras: 星巴克(Starbucks)(SBUX-US) 週四(29日)公布的第四季財報好壞參半，儘管同店銷售明顯成長，但營收及國際市場銷售不及預期，盤後股價轉跌，公司正尋求逐步走出轉型計畫，進一步加速成長。
據《Yahoo Finance》報導，這家咖啡巨頭連續第五季公布優於預期的同店銷售成長，增幅達 7.2%，高於華爾街預估的 6.2%。成長主要由美國市場帶動，當地銷售額增加 7.7%。其中，平均客單價約成長 5%，反映顧客在星巴克的消費金額提高，交易筆數則增加約 2%。
執行長 Brian Niccol 表示，「我們有明確的計畫，一直按照計畫推進，而且計畫正在發揮作用。」他補充，公司「營運表現更加穩定一致」，到星巴克消費的顧客也越來越多。
第四季調整後每股盈餘(EPS)為 0.80 美元，高於華爾街預估的 0.71 美元。不過，營收未達預期，為 91 億美元，低於市場預估的 92 億美元，反映星巴克出售中國業務的影響。
國際市場銷售表現也不如華爾街預期，僅成長 0.9%，低於市場原先預估的約 3%。
這份財報也公布了星巴克 2026 會計年度的全年業績，整體表現呈現類似情況：營收低於市場預估，但獲利與同店銷售成長則優於預期。
全年營收成長 2%，達 379 億美元，略低於市場預期的 380 億美元。調整後每股盈餘年增 28%，達 2.72 美元，高於市場預估的 2.62 美元。
全年全球同店銷售成長 6.2%，高於市場預估的 6%，成長動能同樣主要來自北美業務。
Niccol 表示，「我們以成長動能、明確的優先事項，以及對星巴克未來發展更高的期許，進入 2027 會計年度。」
本月稍早，市場傳出星巴克正與 Chipotle 洽談收購事宜。不過，星巴克已於 10 月初澄清相關傳聞，而 Chipotle 的財報電話會議中也未提及此事。
星巴克發言人當時表示，「依照公司政策，我們不會評論傳聞與猜測，但我們希望明確澄清，我們沒有要收購 Chipotle。」
paras_en: Starbucks (SBUX-US) released its fourth‑quarter earnings on Thursday (the 29th) with mixed results: while comparable store sales grew markedly, revenue and international market sales fell short of expectations, causing the stock to dip in after‑hours trading as the company seeks to gradually emerge from its transformation plan and further accelerate growth.

According to Yahoo Finance, the coffee giant posted its fifth consecutive quarter of comparable store sales growth, expanding 7.2% versus Wall Street’s forecast of 6.2%. The growth was driven mainly by the U.S. market, where sales rose 7.7%. Average ticket size grew about 5%, reflecting higher spend per customer, while transaction counts rose roughly 2%.

Chief Executive Brian Niccol said, “We have a clear plan, we’ve been executing it consistently, and the plan is delivering.” He added that the company’s “operating performance is becoming more stable and consistent,” and that more customers are visiting Starbucks.

Adjusted earnings per share for the quarter were $0.80, above Wall Street’s estimate of $0.71. However, revenue missed expectations at $9.1 billion, below the market forecast of $9.2 billion, reflecting the impact of Starbucks’ sale of its China business.
International market sales also lagged Wall Street expectations, growing only 0.9% versus the roughly 3% analysts had projected.
The report also disclosed full‑year results for fiscal 2026, which showed a similar pattern: revenue fell short of forecasts, while profit and comparable store sales outperformed expectations.
Full‑year revenue grew 2% to $37.9 billion, slightly below the market outlook of $38.0 billion. Adjusted EPS rose 28% year‑over‑year to $2.72, beating the consensus estimate of $2.62.
Global comparable store sales for the year increased 6.2%, topping the 6% forecast, with growth momentum again coming primarily from the North American business.
Niccol said, “We are entering fiscal 2027 with growth momentum, clear priorities, and higher expectations for Starbucks’ future.”

Earlier this month, rumors circulated that Starbucks was in talks to acquire Chipotle. Starbucks clarified the speculation in early October, and Chipotle’s earnings call did not mention any such discussion.
A Starbucks spokesperson said at the time, “In accordance with company policy, we do not comment on rumors or speculation, but we want to make it clear that we have no intention to acquire Chipotle.”

隨後美國數據顯示，上周初請領失業金人數為19.4萬人，接近五十七年最低，突顯勞動力市場保持韌性，另外9月個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數與核心PCE物價指數漲幅分別擴大至3.6%及3.1%，強化FED於12月升息的預期，同時受益於具韌性的消費者支出和人工智能(AI)推動企業投資，第三季度國內生產總值(GDP)環比年率初值為成長3.4%超過預估值，更為一年來最快增長，但美國科技類股下挫，重現對AI領域的擔憂，推低美元兌日圓回落至157.58低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於157.60-80，支撐於156.40-60。
◆EUR/USD
紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)意外維持利率不變，儘管總裁布雷曼稱該行很可能在12月上調官方隔夜拆款利率(OCR)，令紐元備受壓力，相較昨日數據顯示澳洲第三季進口物價跌1.1%，但出口物價漲1.4%超過前值，而且市場押注澳洲央行(RBA)將在11月3日進行今年第四次升息，促使澳幣兌紐元升至十三年高位，兌美元亦漲至五周高點，支撐歐元兌美元。

隨著歐洲央行(ECB)總裁拉加德辭職，提前於明年2月7日卸任，而且歐元區10月企業與工業景氣指數分別升至0.09及負3.4，但經濟與服務業景氣指數分別降至96.9及5.3，消費者通貨膨脹預期指數亦跌至33.9，打擊歐元兌美元至1.1103低點。隨著ECB如預期維持利率不變，但警告能源成本飆升加大通貨膨脹風險，暗示12月再加息，提振歐元兌美元至1.1185高點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1170-90，阻力於1.1160-80。
◆GBP/USD

週四英國央行(BOE)公布9月數據顯示，M4貨幣供給額較前月降至0.1%及消費者信貸增19.14億英鎊低於預期，而且銀行業者批准抵押貸款件數為53,443件，創2023年12月以來最低，打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3293低點。隨後據美國花旗銀行/YouGov調查，英國民眾10月對未來一年與五年通貨膨脹預期分別降至4.2%及4.0%，但英國財政大臣希利的預算案未能改變BOE將在下周會議升息及明年2月前將再加息一次的預期，推升英鎊兌美元至1.3384高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3370-90阻力於1.3470-90。

paras_en: USD/JPY

The U.S. Federal Reserve (FED) kept rates unchanged as expected and raised its economic outlook. Chair Powell said he is confident the inflation rate can be be brought down to the 2% target without slowing growth or raising unemployment, but he acknowledged inflation remains high, signalling willingness and readiness to act. The market is betting on a rate hike at the December meeting, which supported the dollar on Thursday. Data showed Japan's October consumer confidence index fell to 35.0, pressuring the yen and pushing USD/JPY to a high of 158.12. As North Korea launched a suspected missile near South Korea’s east coast, apparently landing outside Japan’s exclusive economic zone, geopolitical tension rose, adding safe‑haven buying for the yen. Meanwhile, U.S. Treasury sell‑offs slowed and yields retreated from 24‑year highs, but Japanese investors have reduced overseas long‑term bond holdings for the sixth consecutive week as of the week ending Oct. 24, and the Bank of Japan (BOJ) is expected to keep rates unchanged at Friday’s meeting, limiting further yen depreciation.

Subsequent U.S. data showed initial jobless claims last week were 194,000, near a 57‑year low, underscoring labour‑market resilience. September personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index and core PCE rose to 3.6% and 3.1% respectively, reinforcing expectations of a December rate hike. Robust consumer spending and AI‑driven corporate investment helped Q3 GDP grow at an annualised 3.4%, the fastest in a year, but U.S. tech stocks fell, reviving concerns over AI, pulling USD/JPY down to a low of 157.58. The dollar‑yen resistance today is estimated at 157.60‑80, support at 156.40‑60.
EUR/USD

The Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) unexpectedly left rates unchanged, although Governor Bremmer said a December hike to the official cash rate (OCR) is likely, putting pressure on the kiwi. By contrast, Australian data showed Q3 import prices fell 1.1% while export prices rose 1.4% above prior levels, and markets are betting the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) will deliver its fourth hike of the year on Nov. 3, lifting the Aussie against the kiwi to a 13‑year high and also to a five‑week high versus the dollar, which in turn supported EUR/USD.

With ECB President Lagarde resigning early, effective Feb. 7 next year, and the Euro‑zone October business and industrial confidence indices rising to 0.09 and –3.4 respectively, the economy and services confidence indices fell to 96.9 and 5.3, and consumer inflation expectations dropped to 33.9, the euro slipped to a low of 1.1103 against the dollar. The ECB kept rates steady as expected but warned that soaring energy costs raise inflation risks and hinted at a December hike, pushing EUR/USD up to a high of 1.1185. Today’s euro‑dollar support is estimated at 1.1170‑90, resistance at 1.1160‑80.

items.title: 日銀利率暫留1.25% 分析師估12月升至1.5% 終點上看2%
items.title_en: BOJ Keeps Rate at 1.25% – Analysts See 1.5% Rise in December, Target Around 2%
paras: 日本銀行 (日銀) 預計在周五 (30日) 結束的貨幣政策會議上維持基準利率於1.25%不變，但可能在最新季度展望報告中小幅上修下一財政年度的通膨預測，並強調日本基礎通膨已大致達到2%的目標。這將顯示日銀政策重心正從長期刺激通膨，轉向防止物價漲幅超標，為最快12月再次升息保留空間。
《路透社》報導指出，日銀此次預計不會連續兩次會議升息，而是希望進一步觀察先前升息對銀行放款條件與金融環境的影響。不過，日銀可能藉由政策聲明釋出更明確的訊號，表明未來將持續調升利率，逐步使利率接近不刺激、也不抑制經濟活動的中性水準。

這項政策轉向將延續日銀上月傳達的訊息。分析人士指出，日銀已進入較為重視抑制通膨風險的政策階段，未來可能每隔數個月升息一次。瑞穗研究所 (Mizuho Research Institute) 執行經濟學家、日銀前高層門間一夫表示，人工智慧 (AI) 投資帶來的全球價格壓力相當強勁，近期通膨有一部分是由需求增加所推動。他認為，日銀若確認政策方向已經轉變，等於向市場傳達可能每季升息的訊號，並預測日銀可能在12月及明年3月升息。
日銀總裁植田和男會後記者會的談話，也將成為市場觀察未來升息時點與幅度的重要依據。熟悉日銀想法的人士向《路透社》透露，日銀可能在季度展望報告中小幅上修下一財政年度的物價預測，並指出日本基礎通膨已大致達到2%的目標。隨著薪資成長逐漸穩定，企業與家庭的通膨預期也維持在約2%，日銀可能強調，接下來的政策任務是透過逐步升息，讓通膨穩定在目標附近。
日本通膨壓力仍是日銀考慮進一步緊縮政策的主要原因。9月核心消費者物價通膨率在睽違9個月後再次超過日銀2%的目標，中東衝突延長推升燃料成本，也削弱政府燃料補貼對物價的抑制效果。日銀7月公布的季度預測原本就預期，隨著企業持續將成本上升轉嫁給消費者，未來數月通膨可能加速。
日元走弱同樣加劇物價壓力。日元貶值推高進口商品成本，能源價格居高不下則進一步增加企業與家庭負擔。日銀今年6月升息後，9月再度調高利率，兩次升息間隔已短於2024年與2025年大約每年升息兩次的節奏，顯示政策正常化速度正在加快。
根據《路透社》對分析師的調查，多數受訪者預期日銀最快在12月將政策利率由1.25%提高至1.5%，之後明年仍會繼續升息。分析師對本輪升息周期終點利率的預估，主要落在1.75%至2%之間。若日銀明確表示基礎通膨已達到與2%目標一致的水準，市場可能將此解讀為央行不願容忍通膨進一步超標，未來升息步伐也可能更加靈活。
不過，日銀仍須在控制物價與維持經濟穩定之間取得平衡。若過早或過快升息，可能對企業融資、銀行放款及整體經濟活動造成影響；若通膨壓力持續擴大，則可能迫使央行加快緊縮步伐。因此，即使此次會議預計按兵不動，市場仍將密切觀察日銀是否調整通膨預測，以及植田和男對未來政策路徑的說明。
日銀政策轉向也與全球通膨環境相互呼應。AI產業投資熱潮推升部分商品與服務需求，中東衝突則造成能源供應與價格風險，美國與歐洲央行同樣面臨通膨壓力升高的挑戰。對日本而言，能源成本上升、日元偏弱與薪資成長逐步擴散，正共同影響物價走勢。
整體而言，日銀此次會議的關鍵不只在於是否維持1.25%的利率，更在於能否清楚傳達下一階段的政策方向。若日銀確認基礎通膨已接近目標，並上修未來物價預測，將進一步強化市場對12月升息的預期；但實際升息時間與後續幅度，仍取決於通膨、薪資、匯率及金融環境的變化。
paras_en: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) is expected to keep its policy rate unchanged at 1.25% at the monetary‑policy meeting ending on Friday (the 30th), but may slightly raise its inflation forecast for the next fiscal year in the latest quarterly outlook and stress that core inflation has basically reached the 2% target. This would show the BOJ’s focus shifting from long‑term stimulus to preventing price gains from overshooting, leaving room for a possible rate hike as early as December.

Reuters reported that the BOJ does not plan to raise rates at two consecutive meetings, preferring to watch how the previous hike affects banks’ lending conditions and the broader financial environment. However, the central bank may use its policy statement to send a clearer signal that it will keep tightening, gradually moving rates toward a neutral level that neither stimulates nor restrains economic activity.

This policy shift continues the message the BOJ delivered last month. Analysts say the bank has entered a phase that places greater emphasis on curbing inflation risks and may raise rates every few months. Mizuho Research Institute senior economist and former BOJ official Kazuo Kadokawa noted that AI‑driven investment is creating strong global price pressure and that recent inflation is partly demand‑driven. He believes that once the BOJ confirms the policy turn, it will signal to the market a possible quarterly hike and forecasts rate increases in December and March next year.

Comments by BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda after the meeting will be a key reference for the market on the timing and magnitude of future hikes. Sources familiar with the BOJ told Reuters that the bank may modestly lift its price outlook for the next fiscal year in the quarterly outlook and point out that core inflation has essentially hit the 2% goal. With wage growth stabilising, firms and households expect inflation around 2%, and the BOJ may stress that its next task is to bring inflation close to target through gradual rate hikes.

Inflation pressure in Japan remains the main reason the BOJ is considering further tightening. Core CPI in September again exceeded the 2% target for the first time in nine months, while the prolonged Middle‑East conflict has pushed fuel costs higher and weakened the effect of government fuel subsidies. The BOJ’s July quarterly forecast already anticipated that, as firms keep passing higher costs onto consumers, inflation could accelerate in the coming months.

A weaker yen also amplifies price pressure. Yen depreciation raises the cost of imported goods, and persistently high energy prices further increase the burden on firms and households. After the BOJ’s June hike, it raised rates again in September, with the interval between hikes now shorter than the roughly semi‑annual rhythm expected for 2024‑25, indicating an accelerating pace of policy normalisation.

A Reuters poll of analysts found most expect the BOJ to lift the policy rate from 1.25% to 1.5% as early as December, with further hikes likely next year. Analysts’ forecasts for the end‑point of this tightening cycle cluster around 1.75%‑2%. If the BOJ explicitly states that core inflation has reached the 2% target, markets may read that as a sign the central bank will not tolerate further overshoot, making future hikes potentially more flexible.

Nevertheless, the BOJ must balance price control with economic stability. Raising rates too early or too quickly could hurt corporate financing, bank lending and overall activity, while persistent inflation pressure could force a faster tightening. Hence, even if the meeting ends with a hold, markets will watch closely for any revision to inflation forecasts and Governor Ueda’s guidance on the policy path ahead.

The BOJ’s policy turn also mirrors the global inflation environment. AI‑driven investment is boosting demand for certain goods and services, the Middle‑East conflict is creating energy‑supply and price risks, and central banks in the US and Europe face similar inflation‑driving challenges. For Japan, rising energy costs, a soft yen and gradually expanding wages are jointly shaping price dynamics.

Overall, the key to this BOJ meeting is not only whether the 1.25% rate is maintained but also whether the bank can clearly convey its next‑stage policy direction. If the BOJ confirms core inflation is near target and upgrades its price outlook, it will reinforce market expectations of a December hike; however, the actual timing and size of any future moves will still depend on developments in inflation, wages, exchange rates and the financial environment.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走貶 Fed、ECB維持利率不變
items.title_en: <New York FX Market> Dollar Weakens as Fed and ECB Hold Rates Steady
paras: 美元周四(29日)小幅走貶，外匯市場參與者消化聯準會(Fed)與歐洲央行(ECB)的利率決策，歐元則微幅上漲。兩家央行均一如市場普遍預期，決定維持利率不變。另一方面，英國公布由Andy Burnham領導下的首份預算案後，英鎊連續第二個交易日延續漲勢。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報102.02。
聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）週三以10票對2票決定維持主要政策利率不變。聯準會理事庫克(Lisa Cook)與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁哈瑪克克(Beth Hammack)則主張升息1碼。這項結果大致符合市場預期，聯準會先前已於9月進行三年多來首次升息。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策公布後表示，近期經濟展現強勁動能，央行也持續致力於實現2%的年度通膨目標，但他拒絕對未來利率走向提供任何前瞻指引。市場目前普遍預期，聯準會將在12月今年最後一次會議上升息。
華許表示，「自我們9月採取政策行動以來，金融與信貸環境已開始出現一些變化。正如我們預期，部分企業與家庭面臨的金融與信貸條件已經收緊。市場參與者在資本配置方面也變得更加審慎。」
他接著表示，「儘管整體金融環境已經收緊，但我不願、也無法將其稱為緊縮。不過，整體而言，這些發展有助於實現更長久、更持續的經濟成長與物價穩定。」
Fifth Third Commercial Bank首席美國經濟學家Bill Adams指出，華許這段談話的後半部分，是記者會上最關鍵的一段發言。
Adams表示，「這段話有三個含意。第一，聯準會認為有理由進一步升息，因為『朝著這個方向前進』意味著目標尚未達成。第二，聯準會希望透過適度升息進行經濟週期中段的調整，而不是將利率推升至足以引發嚴重經濟放緩的緊縮水準。第三，即使華許希望自己能放棄前瞻指引，聯準會仍在運用這項政策工具。」
華許也指出，直到12月會議前，還有大量經濟數據將陸續公布，聯準會可以先評估這些數據，再決定是否進一步調整政策。
這波數據發布潮週四正式展開，投資人迎來美國第三季國內生產毛額（GDP）與9月重要通膨數據。
美國經濟分析局的初步估計顯示，美國第三季實質GDP成長3.4%，高於第二季的2.2%，也超越經濟學家預期的3.2%。
另一方面，被廣泛視為聯準會偏好的通膨指標——個人消費支出（PCE）物價指數——9月整體月增0.5%，核心PCE則月增0.3%。
以年增率計算，整體PCE上升3.6%，核心PCE則微升至3.1%。四項數據均符合市場預期，但年增率數據顯示通膨較8月加速，且明顯高於聯準會長期2%的目標。
ECB維持利率不變 歐元微幅上漲
歐元兌美元上漲0.1%，至1.1162美元。
歐洲央行稍早宣布維持三項主要政策利率不變，與聯準會的決策一致。這項決定廣受市場預期。與聯準會相同，市場目前也預期歐洲央行將在12月升息。
央行在聲明中指出，能源價格「持續上漲，對通膨前景構成上行風險，並對經濟成長前景構成下行風險」。
歐洲央行官員也表示，能源衝擊的全部影響仍在逐步顯現，而基礎物價漲幅「迄今大致保持穩定」。此外，官員指出，自上次會議以來，融資環境已經收緊。
央行另宣布，總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)將於明年卸任，提前結束原定為期8年的任期。她目前領導這家央行的時間已略超過7年。
德意志銀行經濟學家Mark Wall表示，「預測歐洲央行的貨幣政策走向正變得更加困難。一個問題是，先前已經實施的兩次升息，加上9月以來金融環境的收緊，是否足以抑制能源通膨風險進一步升高？答案可能是否定的。」
他接著表示，「另一個問題是，歐洲央行領導層的變動是否會影響明年的決策？我們認為，這個機構的重要性高於個別領導者，但其中仍存在不確定性。我們預期央行將在12月再升息一次，將利率提高至2.75%，屆時拉加德仍將擔任總裁，而這可能就是本輪升息週期的終點。」
英國預算案獲市場青睞 英鎊延續漲勢
英鎊兌美元上漲0.3%，至1.3361美元，連續第二個交易日走高。
英國財政大臣John Healey週三公布預算案，維持財政規則，並避免出現沒有資金來源支撐的額外借款衝擊。預算案也確認，英國財政部在2029／30財政年度保留150億英鎊（約200.5億美元）的財政空間，符合主要交易商的預期。
德銀首席英國經濟學家Sanjay Raja週三表示，「財政大臣在秋季預算案公布前的核心原則是『不要造成傷害』，我們認為他成功達成了這個目標。最大幅度的支出增加來自表外投資。此外，降低生活成本與企業營運成本的措施，也占據了預算案相當重要的部分。」
他補充，「目前，財政大臣為自己爭取到了更多時間，但英國的財政處境正變得愈來愈微妙，更艱難的抉擇仍在後頭。」

paras_en: The dollar slipped slightly on Thursday (the 29th) as forex market participants digested the Federal Reserve’s and European Central Bank’s rate decisions, while the euro edged up modestly. Both central banks, as widely expected, left rates unchanged. Meanwhile, after the UK unveiled its first budget under Andy Burnham, the pound continued its rally for a second consecutive trading day.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.2% to 102.02.

The Federal Open Market Committee voted 10‑2 on Wednesday to keep the target range for the federal funds rate unchanged. Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack voted for a one‑basis‑point hike. The outcome was broadly in line with market expectations, following the Fed’s first rate increase in over three years back in September.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said after the decision that the economy has shown strong momentum recently and the central bank remains committed to achieving its 2% annual inflation goal, but he declined to provide any forward guidance on future rate moves. Markets currently expect the Fed to raise rates at its final meeting in December.

Warsh added, “Since we took policy action in September, the financial and credit environment has begun to show some changes. As we anticipated, financial and credit conditions for some businesses and households have tightened. Market participants have also become more cautious in capital allocation.”

He continued, “Although the overall financial environment has tightened, I am reluctant to label it as ‘tightening.’ Nonetheless, overall these developments help pave the way for more durable, sustained economic growth and price stability.”
Bill Adams, chief U.S. economist at Fifth Third Commercial Bank, noted that the latter part of Warsh’s remarks was the most critical segment of the press conference.

Adams explained, “That statement carries three implications. First, the Fed sees reason to hike further because ‘moving in that direction’ signals the target has not yet been met. Second, the Fed wants to make a moderate mid‑cycle adjustment rather than push rates to a level that would trigger a severe economic slowdown. Third, even though Warsh says he would like to abandon forward guidance, the Fed is still using that tool.”
Warsh also pointed out that a large amount of economic data will be released before the December meeting, allowing the Fed to assess the numbers before deciding on any further policy adjustments.
The data‑release wave kicked off on Thursday, with investors awaiting U.S. third‑quarter GDP and key September inflation figures.
Preliminary estimates from the Bureau of Economic Analysis show real GDP grew 3.4% in Q3, up from 2.2% in Q2 and ahead of economists’ 3.2% forecast.
Meanwhile, the inflation gauge most favored by the Fed – the personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index – rose 0.5% month‑over‑month in September, with core PCE up 0.3%.

On an annual basis, overall PCE increased 3.6% and core PCE edged up to 3.1%. All four numbers matched market expectations, but the annual rates show inflation picking up from August and remaining well above the Fed’s long‑run 2% target.
ECB Holds Rates Steady, Euro Edges Higher
The euro rose 0.1% against the dollar to $1.1162.

The European Central Bank earlier announced it would keep its three main policy rates unchanged, mirroring the Fed’s decision. The move was widely anticipated. Like the Fed, markets now expect the ECB to raise rates in December.
In its statement, the ECB noted that energy prices “continue to rise, posing upside risks to the inflation outlook and downside risks to the growth outlook.”

ECB officials added that the full impact of the energy shock is still unfolding, while underlying price growth “has so far remained broadly stable.” They also said financing conditions have tightened since the last meeting.
The bank also announced that President Christine Lagarde will step down next year, ending her originally eight‑year term early. She has been at the helm for just over seven years.

Deutsche Bank economist Mark Wall said, “Predicting the ECB’s policy path is becoming increasingly difficult. One question is whether the two prior hikes, combined with the tightening financial environment since September, are enough to curb the risk of rising energy‑driven inflation. The answer may well be no.”

He continued, “Another question is whether the change in ECB leadership will affect next year’s decisions. We believe the institution’s importance outweighs any individual leader, but uncertainty remains. We expect another rate hike in December, taking the rate to 2.75%, with Lagarde still in charge, which could mark the end of this tightening cycle.”
UK Budget Wins Market Favor, Pound Continues Rise
The pound rose 0.3% against the dollar to $1.3361, marking a second straight trading‑day gain.

UK Chancellor John Healey unveiled the budget on Wednesday, maintaining fiscal rules and avoiding additional borrowing without a funding source. The plan also confirmed that the Treasury will retain £15 billion (about $20.05 billion) of fiscal space for FY 2029/30, in line with major dealer expectations.

Deutsche Bank’s chief UK economist Sanjay Raja said on Wednesday, “The core principle of the autumn budget was ‘do no harm,’ and we think the chancellor achieved that. The biggest spending increase comes from off‑balance‑sheet investment. Measures to lower living costs and business operating costs also feature prominently in the budget.”
He added, “The chancellor has bought himself more time, but the UK’s fiscal situation is becoming increasingly delicate, and tougher choices lie ahead.”

items.title: 拉加德提前走人！ECB接班兩強浮現 誰來接招通膨與法債風險？
items.title_en: Lagarde Leaves Early! Two Strong Candidates Emerge to Lead the ECB Amid Inflation and French Debt Risks
paras: 歐洲央行(ECB)總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)周四(29日)宣布，將於2027年2月7日提前卸任，比原訂同年10月底任期屆滿提早近九個月。此舉讓接班競逐進入關鍵階段，前西班牙央行總裁戴柯斯(Pablo Hernández de Cos)與前荷蘭央行總裁諾特(Klaas Knot)被視為最有力人選。
綜合《CNBC》與《彭博》報導，歐洲理事會主席柯斯塔(António Costa)表示，繼任者遴選程序將立即展開。歐元區21個成員國可能力爭年底前達成共識，並一併協商明年即將出缺的ECB首席經濟學家與執行理事職位。
拉加德在ECB公布最新利率決策前宣布辭職，感謝團隊過去七年的支持，並獲管理委員會起立鼓掌。她任內歷經疫情、俄烏戰爭與能源價格衝擊；如今歐元區9月通膨再攀三年高點，接班人仍須面對物價與金融穩定的雙重考驗。

戴柯斯民調領先 諾特具金融穩定經驗

現年55歲、目前掌舵國際清算銀行(BIS)的戴柯斯，在《彭博》分析師調查中居於領先。他已獲西班牙總理桑傑士支持，可能在11月29日提前大選勝出的中間偏右人民黨，也表態支持他，降低政黨輪替對提名的影響。
戴柯斯過去被視為偏鴿派，但若提前離開BIS，可能引發對該機構聲譽及接班安排的疑慮，成為競逐ECB職位的阻力。
59歲的諾特則於8月獲荷蘭政府正式提名。他曾任金融穩定委員會(FSB)主席，相關經驗被認為有助應對債市動盪。不過，他自2025年中卸任荷蘭央行總裁後已離開決策第一線一段時間，加上荷蘭過去已出過ECB總裁，可能影響各國支持意願。
諾特原被視為鷹派，曾反對前總裁德拉吉的部分寬鬆政策，之後立場逐漸溫和。他本月仍表示，經濟與地緣政治衝擊可能要求ECB未來幾年略偏向緊縮。

法國債務風險升溫 接班角力牽動政策方向

接班安排不僅涉及專業能力，也牽涉國籍、區域與性別平衡。德國央行總裁內格爾(Joachim Nagel)、義大利央行總裁帕內塔(Fabio Panetta)，以及歐洲投資銀行總裁卡爾維尼奧(Nadia Calviño)，也曾被點名；卡爾維尼奧已否認參選意願，但仍有人認為，各國可能尋求另一名女性接任。
新總裁除須讓通膨回到2%，也得處理法國債務壓力與歐元區公債利差擴大的風險。法國明年總統大選更添變數，市場正討論ECB是否可能動用干預工具。
《彭博》經濟研究認為，相較戴柯斯，諾特可能採取較緊的貨幣政策，對干預法國債市也較不積極。Berenberg首席經濟學家Holger Schmieding則指出，諾特的金融穩定經驗可能成為優勢，但ECB無意替法國失衡的財政政策埋單。
至於拉加德下一步，英國《金融時報》(FT)曾報導，她是世界經濟論壇下一任主席的熱門人選；她近期則暗示，無意角逐2027年法國總統。
paras_en: ECB President Christine Lagarde announced on Thursday the 29th that she will step down early on February 7, 2027, nearly nine months before her term was set to end in late October 2027. Her early departure pushes the succession race into a critical phase, with former Spanish central bank governor Pablo Hernández de Cos and former Dutch central bank governor Klaas Knot seen as the strongest contenders.

According to reports from CNBC and Bloomberg, European Council President António Costa said the selection process for her successor will start immediately. The 21 euro‑area member states are expected to strive for a consensus by the end of the year and will also negotiate the appointments for the ECB’s chief economist and an executive board seat that will become vacant next year.

Lagarde resigned just before the ECB announced its latest rate decision, thanking her team for seven years of support and receiving a standing ovation from the management board. Her tenure spanned the pandemic, the Russia‑Ukraine war and energy price shocks; now euro‑area inflation in September has climbed to a three‑year high, and her successor will still have to face the dual challenge of price stability and financial stability.

At 55, de Cos, who now heads the Bank for International Settlements, leads a Bloomberg analyst poll. He has the backing of Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez and the centre‑right People’s Party, which is expected to win an early election on November 29, further reducing the impact of a change of government on his nomination.

De Cos has previously been viewed as dovish, but an early departure from the BIS could raise concerns about the institution’s reputation and succession plan, potentially becoming a hurdle in the race for the ECB chairmanship.

The 59‑year‑old Knot was formally nominated by the Dutch government in August. He previously chaired the Financial Stability Board, experience seen as useful for dealing with bond‑market turbulence. However, he left the front line of decision‑making after stepping down as Dutch central bank governor in mid‑2025, and the fact that the Netherlands has already produced an ECB president may affect the level of support from other countries.

Knot was originally seen as a hawk, having opposed some of former President Draghi’s easing measures, but his stance has gradually softened. He said this month that economic and geopolitical shocks could require the ECB to tilt slightly more towards tightening over the next few years.

The succession not only involves professional competence but also considerations of nationality, regional balance and gender. Germany’s central bank president Joachim Nagel, Italy’s central bank governor Fabio Panetta and European Investment Bank president Nadia Calviño have also been mentioned; Calviño has denied any interest in running, yet some argue that countries may still look for another woman to take the role.

The new president will have to bring inflation back to 2% while also dealing with French debt pressures and the risk of widening sovereign‑bond spreads across the euro area. France’s presidential election next year adds further uncertainty, and markets are debating whether the ECB might resort to intervention tools.

Bloomberg’s economic research suggests that, compared with de Cos, Knot may pursue a tighter monetary stance and be less inclined to intervene in the French bond market. Berenberg chief economist Holger Schmieding notes that Knot’s financial‑stability background could be an advantage, but the ECB has no intention of footing the bill for France’s imbalanced fiscal policy.

As for Lagarde’s next move, the Financial Times reported that she is a leading candidate to become the next chair of the World Economic Forum; she has recently hinted that she has no intention of running for the French presidency in 2027.

items.title: 印尼央行積極護盤 印尼盾連跌6日後迎來反彈
items.title_en: Indonesia Central Bank Actively Supports Market as Rupiah Rebounds After Six Days of Decline
paras: 印尼盾(IDR)在經歷連續6個交易日下跌後，周四(29日)強勁反彈，以擺脫在歷史低點附近徘徊。
美元兌印尼盾匯率自 10 月 27 日創下的近5個月高點 18,223 回落，盤中一度走軟至 18,185，隨後回升至 18,108 至 18,127 區間，跌幅達 0.4%，有望創下自 9 月 30 日以來的最大單日跌幅。
FXStreet 分析師 Akhtar Faruqui 指出，印尼盾走強主要受到印尼中央銀行積極護盤的支撐。印尼央行重申，將持續透過無本金交割遠期外匯(NDF)、國內無本金交割遠期外匯(DNDF)、現貨市場干預，以及在次級市場購入國債等多重工具以穩定匯市。
外部環境方面，美國聯準會決議將基準利率維持在 3.75%–4.00% 不變。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)發表談話時重申，公開市場委員會(FOMC)將堅守物價穩定與 2% 的通膨目標，並強調底層經濟成長依然強勁。
不過此項利率決策並未獲得全體一致同意，聯準會理事庫克(Lisa Cook)與克里夫蘭Fed主席哈馬克(Beth Hammack)投下反對票，主張應立即升息1碼(25 個基點)以應對居高不下的物價壓力。華許更為溫和的表態被市場解讀為偏向鴿派，進一步推升了亞洲主要貨幣。
儘管央行出手干預，印尼當地金融市場仍承受顯著壓力。印尼 10 年期公債殖利率一度攀升至7.7%–7.707% 的近年新高，顯著高於 2026 財年預算設定的 6.9% 基準，隨後微幅下降 3 個基點至 7.62%。
由於市場對財政風險及通膨隱憂未除，加上印尼在 MSCI 指數中面臨可能被降級為獨立市場狀態的不確定性，導致外資持續賣超並引發資本外流疑慮。雅加達綜合指數仍下挫 2% 至 5,175.15 點。
交易員目前正密切關注即將公布的 9 月貿易數據與 10 月通膨報告，以評估後續經濟與匯率走勢。
paras_en: The Indonesian rupiah (IDR) staged a strong rebound on Thursday (the 29th) after six consecutive trading days of decline, shaking off its slide near historic lows.

The USD/IDR rate fell from the near‑five‑month high of 18,223 set on October 27, slipping intraday to as low as 18,185 before climbing back into the 18,108‑18,127 range, a drop of about 0.4% that could mark the biggest single‑day decline since September 30.

FXStreet analyst Akhtar Faruqui said the rupiah’s strength is mainly backed by the Bank Indonesia’s active market‑support measures. The central bank reiterated it will continue to use a mix of non‑deliverable forwards (NDF), domestic NDFs (DNDF), spot market interventions and purchases of government bonds in the secondary market to stabilise the exchange rate.

On the external front, the U.S. Federal Reserve kept its policy rate unchanged at 3.75%‑4.00%. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh, in his remarks, reaffirmed that the Federal Open Market Committee will stay committed to price stability and a 2% inflation target, stressing that underlying economic growth remains robust.

However, the rate decision was not unanimous; Fed Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack voted against it, arguing for an immediate 25‑basis‑point hike to curb persistent inflation pressures. Warsh’s more dovish tone was read by markets as a tilt toward easing, further lifting major Asian currencies.

Despite the central bank’s intervention, Indonesia’s domestic financial markets remain under significant strain. The 10‑year government bond yield briefly spiked to a recent high of 7.7%‑7.707%, well above the 6.9% benchmark set in the FY2026 budget, before easing by three basis points to 7.62%.

Because fiscal‑risk and inflation concerns persist, and Indonesia faces the possibility of being reclassified as a frontier market in MSCI indices, foreign investors continue to sell, raising worries about capital outflows. The Jakarta Composite Index fell another 2% to 5,175.15 points.
Traders are now closely watching the upcoming September trade data and October inflation report to gauge the next moves in the economy and the rupiah.

items.title: 歐洲央行料將維持利率不變 以評估法國動盪及能源風險
items.title_en: ECB Expected to Keep Rates Unchanged to Assess French Turmoil and Energy Risks
paras: 歐洲中央銀行(ECB)周四(29日)預計將基準存款利率維持在 2.50% 不變，暫緩升息步伐。儘管中東伊朗衝突引發原油價格震盪與通膨隱憂，但在歐元區經濟動態放緩與法國國債市場劇烈波動的雙重夾擊下，決策者普遍選擇維持政策現狀，並將目光投向 12 月的政策展望。
歐元區當前通膨率接近 4%，遠高於 2% 的政策目標，但升幅主要集中於能源領域。彭博經濟研究(Bloomberg Economics)分析師David Powell與Simona Delle Chiaie指出：「歐洲央行幾乎肯定會在本次會議暫停升息；借貸成本上升已收緊金融條件，面對主權債券市場動盪，決策者希望避免火上澆油。」
德國貝倫貝格銀行首席經濟學家Holger Schmieding表示：「歐洲央行可能會表明，近期油價再度飆升，使通膨上行風險比 9 月時更為顯著。」
歐洲央行管理委員會委員Pierre Wunsch指出，市場預估央行未來將採取更多行動「是合理的基準情境，但全球仍處於極具不確定性的環境中」。貨幣市場目前定價年底前仍可能重啟升息，預估存款利率最終可能推升至 3.25%。
除了貨幣政策路線，法國公債市場的動盪成為即時挑戰。受預算赤字膨脹、政治分歧與社會動盪影響，法國 10 年期國債殖利率升破 5%，創下 24 年新高，與德國基準公債的利差亦擴大至 15 年新高。
針對央行是否干預，法國安盛集團(AXA Group)首席經濟學家Gilles Moec認為：「保留歐洲央行干預市場的可能性至關重要。」
但是，Lombard Odier歐洲、中東及非洲地區投資長Nannette Hechler-Fayd'Herbe強調：「干預門檻相當高，除非真的面臨擴散風險、金融市場運作失序或全歐流動性緊縮，否則不預計歐央行會動用傳播保護工具(TPI)。」
Algebris 基金管理公司經濟學家團隊分析，目前法國風險仍侷限於國內，若發生溢出效應，央行可能考慮對其他成員國啟用 TPI，但對法國保持立場。
市場同時高度關注歐洲央行總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)的去留問題，傳聞指出拉加德可能提前接任世界經濟論壇(WEF)主席。日本三菱日聯金融集團(MUFG)資深經濟學家Henry Cook警告：「在央行面臨金融條件收緊、能源價格上漲及總體經濟前景不確定性升級之際，領導層出現任何不確定性都絕非理想狀況。」
目前荷蘭前央行總裁 Klaas Knot 與西班牙前央行總裁 Pablo Hernandez de Cos 被視為接任歐洲央行總裁的熱門人選。
paras_en: The European Central Bank (ECB) on Thursday (the 29th) is expected to keep its key deposit rate at 2.50%, pausing its rate‑hiking cycle. Despite oil price swings and inflation concerns sparked by the Middle‑East conflict involving Iran, policymakers are broadly opting to maintain the status quo amid slowing euro‑area economic activity and sharp volatility in the French sovereign bond market, turning their attention to the policy outlook for December.

Euro‑area inflation is currently close to 4%, well above the 2% target, but the rise is largely confined to energy. Bloomberg Economics analysts David Powell and Simona Delle Chiaie note, “The ECB is almost certain to pause rate hikes at this meeting; higher borrowing costs have already tightened financial conditions, and facing sovereign‑bond market turbulence, policymakers want to avoid adding fuel to the fire.”
Germany’s Berenberg Bank chief economist Holger Schmieding said, “The ECB may point out that the recent surge in oil prices makes inflation‑upside risks more pronounced than they were in September.”

ECB Governing Council member Pierre Wunsch said that market expectations of further ECB action “are a reasonable baseline scenario, but the world remains highly uncertain.” Money markets are still pricing in the possibility of a rate hike before year‑end, with the deposit rate potentially climbing to 3.25% eventually.

Beyond monetary policy, turbulence in the French sovereign‑bond market is an immediate challenge. Driven by a widening budget deficit, political divisions and social unrest, the yield on France’s 10‑year bond has broken above 5%, a 24‑year high, while the spread over German benchmark bonds has widened to a 15‑year peak.
Regarding possible ECB intervention, AXA Group chief economist Gilles Moec said, “Keeping the option of ECB market intervention open is crucial.”

However, Lombard Odier’s head of investment for Europe, the Middle East and Africa, Nannette Hechler‑Fayd’Herbe, stressed, “The intervention threshold is quite high; unless there is a genuine spill‑over risk, a breakdown in market functioning, or a Europe‑wide liquidity squeeze, the ECB is not expected to deploy its Transmission Protection Instrument (TPI).”

Algebris fund‑management economists argue that French risk remains largely domestic; if spill‑over effects emerge, the ECB might consider using TPI for other member states, but would maintain its stance on France.

Markets are also closely watching the fate of ECB President Christine Lagarde, with rumours that she could take over the World Economic Forum (WEF) chairmanship ahead of schedule. Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group senior economist Henry Cook warned, “When the central bank faces tighter financial conditions, rising energy prices and escalating macro‑economic uncertainty, any uncertainty about its leadership is far from ideal.”
Former Dutch central‑bank governor Klaas Knot and former Spanish central‑bank governor Pablo Hernández de Cos are currently seen as the leading candidates to succeed Lagarde as ECB president.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】 FED維持利率不變，美元漲勢減弱
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: Fed Holds Rates Steady, Dollar Gains Lose Momentum
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國9月新屋銷售下降，但人工智能(AI)投資熱潮注入動力，企業設備支出強勁增長及耐久財訂單增幅超過預期，而且10月消費者信心指數上升，突顯經濟狀況良好及通貨膨脹上行風險，市場普遍預計美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)週三維持利率不變，並暗示12月調整利率，提供美元支撐，但日本趨勢通貨膨脹指數創三年高位，鞏固日本央行(BOJ)升息理由，而且日本公債收益率上升及月末資金流入，週三推低美元兌日圓至157.63低點。

隨著也門戰事持續，外界擔憂中東能源進一步受擾提升油價，美元仍保持避險貨幣地位，而且儘管日本政府一再否認，但其整體立場偏向再通貨膨脹，可能設法推遲BOJ升息，令日圓承壓，美元兌日圓升至158.34高點。隨後美國公布9月商品貿易逆差意外擴大至1,349億美元，並據FED以10票贊成、理事庫克和克利夫蘭聯邦儲備銀行總裁哈馬克主張加息25個基點，如預期維持聯邦基金利率區間在3.75%-4.00%，而且FED主席沃什在新聞會表示，經濟成長強勁的和通貨膨脹高企，未來仍可能再收緊貨幣政策，芝加哥商品交易所（CME）的FedWatch工具則顯示FED在12月加息的機率85%，但本次會議結果已在廣泛預期中，引發美元兌日圓回落。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於157.50-70，阻力於158.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

昨日澳洲公布第三季消費者物價指數(CPI)較前季升1.3%及較上年同期漲3.9%，澳洲央行(RBA)總裁布洛克則警告物價壓力仍居高不下，政策制定者將於下周討論今年四次升息是否足以實現通貨膨脹目標，提升RBA下週二加息25個基點的機率至88%，但紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)意外維持利率不變，儘管稱未來或仍需收緊政策，引發紐元暴跌，並據德國報告稱，受中國需求轉弱拖累出口，今年德國對亞太地區二十九個經濟體的出口料下降3.2%至1,853億歐元，對亞太貿易逆差料創紀錄高位，推低歐元兌美元至1.1131低點。
據紐倫堡市場決策研究所(NIM)與市場研究機構GfK調查，德國11月消費者信心指數下滑至負30.8，但歐洲央行(ECB)週四的政策會議預計維持利率不變，市場關注ECB對能源價格推動的第二輪通貨膨脹效應提供任何暗示，而且FED決議後美元走弱，歐元兌美元反彈至1.1169高點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1140-60，支撐於1.1060-80。

U.S. September new‑home sales fell, but a surge in artificial‑intelligence (AI) investment is providing a boost, corporate equipment spending is rising strongly and durable‑goods orders are growing faster than expected. In addition, the October consumer confidence index rose, highlighting a solid economic backdrop and upward inflation risks. The market broadly expects the Federal Reserve to keep rates unchanged on Wednesday and signal a possible rate adjustment in December, which would support the dollar. Meanwhile, Japan’s trend inflation index hit a three‑year high, reinforcing the Bank of Japan’s case for tightening. Higher Japanese government‑bond yields and end‑of‑month fund inflows pushed the dollar‑yen down to a low of 157.63 on Wednesday.

As the war in Yemen drags on, concerns that Middle‑East energy supplies could be further disrupted and push oil prices higher keep the dollar in safe‑haven mode. Although the Japanese government repeatedly denies it, its overall stance leans toward re‑inflation, which could help delay BOJ rate hikes, putting pressure on the yen and lifting the dollar‑yen to a high of 158.34. Later, the U.S. reported an unexpectedly large September goods‑trade deficit of $134.9 billion. The Fed, with ten votes in favor, saw Chairman Cook and Cleveland Fed President Harker argue for a 25‑basis‑point hike, but the expectation remains to keep the federal funds rate in the 3.75‑4.00 % range. Fed Chair Waller said in a news conference that strong growth and high inflation could lead to further monetary tightening. The CME FedWatch tool shows an 85 % probability of a December rate hike. The meeting outcome was widely anticipated, prompting the dollar‑yen to retreat. The dollar‑yen is expected to find support around 157.50‑70 and face resistance near 158.30‑50 today.
EUR/USD

Yesterday Australia released its Q3 consumer price index, up 1.3 % from the previous quarter and 3.9 % year‑on‑year. RBA Governor Philip Lowe warned that price pressures remain high, and policymakers will discuss next week whether four rate hikes this year are enough to meet the inflation target, raising the odds of a 25‑basis‑point hike on Tuesday to 88 %. In contrast, the Reserve Bank of New Zealand unexpectedly left rates unchanged, though it said further tightening may be needed, sending the kiwi tumbling. A German report said that weaker Chinese demand is dragging down exports, with Germany’s exports to 29 Asia‑Pacific economies projected to fall 3.2 % to €185.3 billion, and the trade deficit with the region likely to hit a record high, pushing the euro‑dollar down to a low of 1.1131.

The ECB is expected to keep rates unchanged at Thursday’s policy meeting, and markets are watching for any hints about a second‑round inflation effect from energy prices. After the Fed decision, the dollar weakened and the euro rose to a high of 1.1169 against the dollar. The euro‑dollar is projected to face resistance around 1.1140‑60 and support near 1.1060‑80 today.

paras: 美元周三(28日)兌主要貨幣走跌，聯準會(Fed)公布符合市場預期的利率決策。另一方面，紐西蘭央行意外決定維持利率不變，導致紐西蘭幣大幅下跌。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.2%，報102.15。
聯準會一如預期維持利率不變，選擇等到下週美國期中選舉結束後，再決定是否調整借貸成本，同時等待更多通膨走勢的相關數據。
聯準會公布決策後，美元短線反應平淡，但隨著主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在記者會上發言，美元隨後開始走弱。
歐元兌美元上漲0.32%，至1.1160美元。
美元兌日元下跌0.04%，至157.87日元。
Bannockburn Global Forex首席市場策略師Marc Chandler表示，「由於殖利率曲線趨陡，美元比聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前更為疲軟。」
華許開始舉行記者會後，美國公債殖利率曲線趨陡。其中，通常隨聯準會利率預期變動的2年期公債殖利率下跌1.46個基點，至4.722%。
根據芝商所（CME）FedWatch工具，目前市場預期聯準會12月升息的機率接近85%。
Ocean Park Asset Management投資長James St. Aubin表示，「這次會議的結果完全符合市場預期，升息的可能性原本就不高。」
英國財政大臣John Healey週三向國會表示，政府將提高銀行、博弈業者、儲蓄者及房東的稅負，同時收緊亞馬遜等線上市場平台的加值型營業稅規定，以籌措英國預算方案所需資金。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.12%，至1.3323美元。
英鎊兌歐元則下跌約0.08%。
紐西蘭幣重挫
紐西蘭央行將利率維持在2.75%，令原本預期央行將升息的多數經濟學家感到意外。消息公布後，紐幣一度下跌1.74%，至0.5583美元。
加拿大央行則是三年多來首度調升政策利率，並表示，為避免能源成本飆升進一步推升整體通膨，未來可能還需要繼續升息。
加拿大幣兌美元上漲0.37%，至每美元兌1.4加幣。
Chandler表示，「紐西蘭央行的決策令市場失望，紐幣因此遭到拋售，也是G10貨幣中表現最弱貨幣。加拿大央行剛剛升息，但這項決策符合市場預期，因此加幣對升息的反應不大。」
市場預期，歐洲央行(ECB)與日本央行(BoJ)將分別於週四及週五公布貨幣政策決策，兩家央行都預計將維持政策利率不變。

paras_en: The dollar fell against major currencies on Wednesday (the 28th) as the Federal Reserve announced a rate decision that matched market expectations. Meanwhile, the Reserve Bank of New Zealand unexpectedly left rates unchanged, sending the New Zealand dollar sharply lower.
In the late New York session, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.2% to 102.15.
The Fed, as anticipated, kept rates steady, opting to wait until after next week’s U.S. midterm elections before deciding whether to adjust borrowing costs, while also awaiting more inflation data.
After the Fed’s decision, the dollar’s short‑term reaction was muted, but it began to weaken after Chair Kevin Warsh spoke at the press conference.
The euro rose 0.32% against the dollar, to $1.1160.
The dollar fell 0.04% against the yen, to ¥157.87.
Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “With the yield curve steepening, the dollar is weaker than it was before the FOMC meeting.”
Following Warsh’s press briefing, the U.S. Treasury yield curve steepened. The two‑year Treasury yield, which usually moves with Fed rate expectations, dropped 1.46 basis points to 4.722%.
According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market now sees an almost 85% chance of a rate hike by the Fed in December.
James St. Aubin, chief investment officer at Ocean Park Asset Management, said, “The outcome of this meeting was fully in line with market expectations; the likelihood of a hike was never high.”

U.K. Treasury Secretary John Healey told Parliament on Wednesday that the government will raise taxes on banks, gambling operators, savers and landlords, and tighten value‑added tax rules for online platforms such as Amazon to fund the budget.
The pound rose 0.12% against the dollar, to $1.3323.
The pound fell about 0.08% against the euro.
New Zealand dollar crashes
The Reserve Bank of New Zealand kept its policy rate at 2.75%, surprising most economists who had expected a hike. After the announcement, the kiwi dropped as much as 1.74% to $0.5583.

The Bank of Canada, for the first time in more than three years, raised its policy rate and warned that further hikes may be needed to prevent soaring energy costs from pushing overall inflation higher.
The Canadian dollar rose 0.37% against the U.S. dollar, to C$1.40 per dollar.

Chandler added, “The RBNZ’s decision disappointed the market, leading to a sell‑off of the kiwi, which became the weakest among G10 currencies. The BoC’s hike was expected, so the Canadian dollar’s reaction was muted.”
Markets expect the European Central Bank (ECB) and the Bank of Japan (BoJ) to announce their monetary‑policy decisions on Thursday and Friday, respectively, with both likely to keep rates unchanged.
